v: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s sanctuary is a throne of glory, set on high since the beginning of creation. This does not refer only to a physical location but to the incomparable authority and honor of God, whose glory surpasses everything.

It is like an ancient castle standing high on a mountaintop, which remains standing no matter the wind and rain. God’s throne is just as secure and will not be shaken by any power or challenge. When we have this assurance in our hearts, we can stand firm in difficulties and trials, because we know that God’s throne can never be shaken and His glory is always with us.

A pastor lost his home and loved ones in war, but he never wavered in his faith in God. He firmly believed that whatever the circumstances, God’s throne remained on high and His glory still shone. With this conviction he continued to shepherd his church and helped many who were suffering regain faith and hope. This pastor’s testimony reminds us that God’s throne is the foundation of our faith, and that whatever storms come, we can find comfort and strength in His glory.

Dear family, let us fix our eyes on God’s throne and remember His glory and authority. Whatever challenges and difficulties we meet in life, let us not forget that God’s throne has been set on high from the beginning and His glory never fades.
ah: Jeremiah 17:12 describes our sanctuary as a throne of glory set on high from the beginning. This reminds us that God’s presence and holy dwelling are always above all else, and are the center of our faith and life. Here is how we can put these principles into practice:
a: Keep a heart of reverence
Keep an attitude of reverence for God in every area of life. Let our thoughts and actions always reflect high honor and awe for God.
Seek God’s will first
Before making a decision, first seek God’s guidance and will. Through prayer and meditation on the Bible, let God’s Word be the foundation of our decisions.
Serve in the church
Take an active part in the church’s service and activities, offering yourself to God’s work. By serving others, we also practice giving glory to God.
Maintain a holy lifestyle
Every choice in life should reflect respect for God’s throne of glory. Stay away from temptation and sin, and strive to be pure in word and deed.
Set an example in family and community
Let our families and communities see how our lives are guided by God’s glory. Through positive influence, lead more people to know and worship God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the throne of glory You have prepared on high for us. Help us to approach You with reverent hearts, and in every action and decision to seek Your will. Give us strength to serve actively in the church, the family, and the community, and to glorify You with holy lives. May our lives be a witness to Your glory and lead more people to know You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense the presence of God’s glory every day, and find strength and comfort before His throne. Amen!

v: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
b: This verse reminds us that God’s house is the place where His glory is revealed, and a place we should love and treasure. It refers not only to a physical church or place of worship but to the reverence and honor for God in our hearts.

It is like a brilliant lighthouse that, however fierce the storm, stands there always, guiding ships lost in the dark to find their way. God’s house and the place where His glory dwells are the same. Whatever challenges or difficulties we meet in life, when we come into God’s house, or worship Him in our hearts, we can find peace and comfort within.

A young man met many setbacks and challenges in life. He lost his job, and his relationship ran into trouble. Yet he kept going to church every week for worship and sought God’s guidance in prayer. Once, in the church, he sensed God’s presence and glory, and hope and strength were rekindled in his heart. He began to face the challenges of life actively, and finally found a new job, and his relationship was restored. His testimony tells us that when we love God’s house and the place where His glory dwells, we can find strength and guidance in His light.

Dear family, let us come often into God’s house in life, whether the physical church or worshiping Him in our hearts, and feel His glory and presence. Let us worship our God with hearts of reverence and love, and find in His light the direction and strength to go forward.
ah: Psalm 26:8 reminds us to love the dwelling of the LORD, that is, His house, the place where He reveals His glory. Here are concrete ways to put this principle into practice in daily life:
a: Take part in church gatherings

Take an active part in the church’s gatherings and activities, because it is the place where we experience God’s glory. Let us go to church not only on special holidays but often, to gather with God and fellow believers.
Maintain and respect the church environment
Care for and look after the church’s space and facilities. Take an active part in cleaning, repairing, and beautifying the church so that God’s dwelling is always a symbol of glory and welcome.
Serve in the church
Whether by singing in the choir, teaching Sunday school, or other ways of serving, take an active part and show that the church is a place of God’s glory.
Seek God in personal devotions
Set up a space at home for communing with God, praying, and having devotions, as a glorious dwelling where you meet God every day. In this space, pray and read the Bible at set times.
Lead family and friends to glorify God
Share with family and friends the testimony of how the church has become the dwelling place of God’s glory. Invite them to join church activities and experience God’s glory for themselves.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing Your glory in the church, and thank You for letting us love and treasure Your dwelling. Help us to gather often in Your house and to honor You through service and worship. May our homes and lives be a witness to Your glory and lead people to come before You. We pray in the name of the victorious Lord Jesus.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find peace and strength in God’s house every day, and grow in His glory. Amen!

v: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.
b: This verse shows God’s glory in and care for His house. God’s house is His dwelling, the place where we gather to worship and offer our thanks and worship. It refers not only to a physical building but to the temple of each person’s heart.

It is like a garden carefully cultivated by a gardener: in the heat of summer or the cold of winter, you can see his hard work and love for the garden. In the same way, God’s house is a place that He has carefully established and maintained, and He wants us to find spiritual nourishment and growth there.

Here is a true story. A young man, because of the pressures and difficulties of life, felt lost and in despair. He happened to walk into a church. Although he had not been a churchgoer before, that day he felt God’s presence and love. From then on he came to church every week for worship, and found peace of heart and direction there. His life began to change. He found a steady job, and his family relationships were mended. He said that God’s house became a haven for his life, restoring his hope for living.

Dear family, let us treasure God’s house, whether the physical church or the place of worship in our hearts. When we offer our hearts to God, He will surely show His glory in our hearts and give us strength and hope.
ah: Isaiah 60:7 reminds us that God will glorify His house and make our offerings acceptable. In our daily lives, we can take the following practical steps to put this verse’s teaching into practice:
a: Take an active part in building and maintaining the church
Whether through donations of time, money, or skills, we should commit ourselves to the practical needs of the church, helping to maintain and beautify God’s house.
Offer your talents and service in the church
Take an active part in the church’s music, hospitality, teaching, or other ministries. Our devotion can be a way for God to bless His house.
Pray to support the church’s ministry
Pray for the church’s leaders, service, and activities, asking God to give wisdom and direction so that every activity glorifies His name.
Promote and support evangelism and outreach
By supporting and joining in the church’s evangelism and community service, help extend the reach of God’s glory.
Teach and encourage fellow believers
In group meetings or personal interactions, encourage and build up others with God’s Word, so that each person becomes a living stone that glorifies God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us such a glorious sanctuary in which to worship You. Help us to make Your house ever more glorious through our giving, service, and prayer. May every action and every offering be a witness to Your glory. Bless our church and make it a dwelling of Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find peace of heart and spiritual strength in God’s house, and keep growing in His glory. Amen!

v: and I will shake all nations. The treasure of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says the LORD of Armies.
b: This verse reveals a magnificent picture: God will move the whole world and bring incomparable treasures to glorify His house. Here “treasures” refers not only to material wealth and offerings but to spiritual contributions of the heart.

Imagine a navigator crossing a vast ocean in search of unknown treasure. He goes through storms and tempests, and finally discovers an island full of jewels. These treasures symbolize spiritual gifts and the riches of the kingdom of heaven, prepared for him by God. Just as the navigator brings the treasure home to bring honor to his country, each of us is also called to bring our spiritual treasures to fill and glorify God’s house.

This story is not only an adventure of seeking treasure but a story of faith and devotion. Whenever we give our time, talents, or resources to God, we are turning the treasures of this world into spiritual glory. When we serve others, share the gospel, and even keep our faith in hardship, we are bringing glory to God’s house.
Dear family, let us all be people who bring glory to God’s house. Wherever we are, our lives and conduct can reflect His radiance and be filled with the spiritual treasures God has given us.
ah: Haggai 2:7 reminds us that God will bring His glory into His temple. In our daily lives, we can put the teaching of this verse into practice in the following ways:
a: Financial giving
Take an active part in the giving programs of the church or religious organizations, supporting God’s work with our wealth and so bringing material and spiritual treasures.
Take an active part in church activities
Whether attending worship, group meetings, or service opportunities, active participation can strengthen our relationship with God and add vitality and glory to His temple.
Spiritual offering
Through personal prayer, Bible reading, and meditation, offer our hearts to God, so that His dwelling is filled with glory by our worship and love for Him.
Share the gospel
Share God’s love and the gospel with others, not only in words but also in actions, so that more people come to know God, and so increase the glory of His temple.
Build spiritual friendships
Build strong spiritual relationships in the church or faith groups. These relationships will encourage one another to grow in faith and together create a community full of glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding us through Your Word that You desire to bring glory into Your temple. Give us wisdom and strength to show Your glory through our giving, participation, worship, and relationships. Accept every offering of ours, and use us to carry out Your plan for this world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you carry heavenly treasure every day, so that wherever you are is full of God’s glory. Amen!

v: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says the LORD of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give peace,’ says the LORD of Armies.”
b: In this passage God assures us that He will not only rebuild His house but will make its glory greater than that of all former ages. The glory here is not merely material or structural; it concerns spiritual awakening and God’s presence at a deeper level.

It is like an architect who designs a building more magnificent and innovative than before. When we see the building, we are drawn not only by its appearance but moved by the progress it represents and the possibilities of the future. On the spiritual level, God works among us in the same way. He continually renews and rebuilds, so that our lives and church communities are more full of His glory than ever.

The process is like a gardener who keeps pruning the old branches and planting new seedlings, looking forward to a more flourishing garden in the future. Each pruning may bring pain, but the result will be new life and beauty. This is how God works in our lives. He cuts away the branches that no longer bear fruit so that we can grow stronger and display new glory.

Dear family, when we go through challenges and rebuilding in life, let us remember God’s promise and believe that what He is doing in our lives will bring greater glory than before. The peace He gives in this place will surpass our understanding.
ah: Haggai 2:9 tells us that God promises that the future glory will be greater than the former glory, and that He will give peace in this place. This is not only a prophecy about a physical temple but a promise to the heart of every believer. We can put this passage’s teaching into practice in daily life in the following ways:
a: Deepen your personal devotions

Spend time each day reading the Bible and praying, letting God’s Word become the foundation on which our hearts are built. Through devotions, we can feel God’s glory in the depths of our hearts more than ever.
Take an active part in church service
Throw yourself into the church’s service and activities, not only to serve the community but as part of building a spiritual family, so that the glory of the church exceeds that of the past.
Spread a message of peace and reconciliation
In daily life, whether in the family, the workplace, or the community, be a messenger of peace. Resolve conflicts and promote reconciliation, so that our surroundings reflect the peace God gives.
Teach and share God’s promises
Share with others what God has done in your life, especially how He has shown greater glory and peace in your life. This can encourage believers and also attract non-believers to seek God.
Live out your faith with gratitude
Whatever the situation, respond to life’s ups and downs with a thankful heart. Recognize that each day is a gift from God, and look for God’s glory in it.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your promise in Haggai 2:9, that You will give us greater glory and peace. Help us to draw near to You daily in our devotions, take an active part in church life, be messengers of peace, and radiate Your glory in our lives. May our hearts and our church experience greater glory than ever, and give Your peace in the process. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find comfort and hope in God’s work, and believe that the future will bring greater glory. Amen!

v: Your right hand, LORD, is glorious in power. Your right hand, LORD, dashes the enemy in pieces.
b: This passage lets us witness God’s power and glory, especially how He shows wonderful strength in difficulty and opposition. God’s glory lies not only in His creation and redemption but in His opposing the forces that oppose His people.

It is like a warrior on an ancient battlefield wielding his sword: every swing shows not only the strength of his power but the mastery of his skill. In the same way, God’s “right hand,” which in the Bible often symbolizes God’s power and authority, is not swung at random but precisely and powerfully destroys the enemy, protecting and saving His people.

It is also like a strong father protecting his child from bullies. The LORD’s mighty right hand not only strikes His enemies but shows His boundless love and protection for us. This picture helps us understand that whatever difficulty or threat we face, we can rely on God’s strength.

A sister named Maria almost lost her life in a car accident, but she firmly believed it was God’s arm that protected her and brought her miraculously back from the edge of death. She recalled that at that moment she felt an invisible power surround her, so that she walked out unharmed from the completely wrecked car. The experience deepened her trust in God’s protecting grace and made her faith firmer.
Dear family, when you feel fear or uncertainty, remember that God’s right hand is mighty and strong. He will not only destroy the enemies that threaten you, but will light your path with His glory.
ah: Exodus 15:6 describes how the LORD, under Moses’ leadership, brought about Israel’s deliverance from Egypt through His mighty right hand, an example of God displaying His glory. From this verse we can learn how to live out the victory of faith in daily life:
a: Ask for God’s intervention
When you meet difficulties or challenges, actively ask for God’s intervention and guidance. Believe that God will open a way for us with His power, as He did at the Red Sea.
Know God’s power
Often recall and proclaim God’s mighty works in our lives. This will strengthen our trust in God, knowing that in any circumstance God’s power is enough to bring a breakthrough.
Witness to God’s works
Share with others how God has shown His power and glory in your life. These testimonies can encourage believers and may draw non-believers to seek to know God.
Stand firm amid hostility

When you face opposition and trials, hold on to your faith and remember how God saved and protected His people in the past. This perseverance is not only a reflection of God’s glory but a testimony to God’s faithfulness.
A life of prayer and praise
Keep praying and praising continually in daily life. This not only strengthens our relationship with God but shows that we rely on Him in any circumstance.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the glory You showed through Your right hand in the book of Exodus. Show Your power in our lives too, and help us to witness Your victory in difficulties and challenges. When we face trials and hostility, give us faith and strength so that we can seek and rely on You in any circumstance. We look forward to seeing more of Your glory displayed in our lives, and to declaring Your works to all who will hear. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. In every day’s challenges may you see God’s mighty right hand that destroys enemies and protects us. Amen!

v: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!
b: This verse reminds us that God’s glory is visible not only on earth but also clearly in the vast heavens. When we look up at the stars, witness the grandeur of a sunset, or admire the sky full of stars, we are actually seeing a direct display of God’s glory.

Like a blue sea glittering gold in the sunlight, our Heavenly Father displays His glory through the beauty and harmony of nature. It is not only a feast for the eyes but a hymn of praise to God’s creativity.

A sister named Maria shared her experience of seeking calm in nature. Climbing a mountain alone, she watched the sunrise from the summit, and suddenly the clouds parted and a beam of light shone down through the gap, lighting up the valley. Maria felt it was God’s personal revelation to her, reminding her that even in the low moments of life, God’s glory finds a way to shine into her life.

Dear family, when we face challenges in daily life, let us not forget to look up at God’s creation, for it is there that we can see the witness of His glory. Let this glory remind us that wherever we are, God is with us, and His goodness and majesty are everywhere.
ah: Psalm 8:1 describes how God’s glory is displayed in the heavens, which leads us to think about how to reflect God’s glory in our daily lives. Here are several ways to put it into practice:
a: Worship in nature
Spend time walking or sitting quietly in nature, observing the sky, plants, and animals, and praising God’s creation in your heart or aloud.
Explore astronomy
By observing the stars and planets, learn about the grandeur of the universe. This can be done with a home telescope or by joining public astronomy events.
Environmental action
Protecting our environment, such as reducing waste, reusing, and recycling, is a way of respecting and preserving the world God created, and reflects respect for His glory.
Share the wonder of creation
Share with others your testimony and reflections on how God shows His glory in creation, whether through social media or personal conversation.
Family activities
Take your children on outdoor activities, teach them about God’s creation, and explore the beauty of nature together, increasing their knowledge of God’s glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for displaying Your glory in the heavens. How wonderful is Your creation! Help us often to remind ourselves to notice Your works in daily life, and to show our worship of You by protecting and appreciating Your creation. As we enjoy the beautiful nature You have given, let us not forget to pass Your glory on to those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. As you observe God’s works in heaven and on earth, may you always remember His greatness and glory. Amen!

v: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
b: This verse makes us think about how nature displays the glory of the Creator through its magnificent beauty. When we see sunrises and sunsets, twinkling stars, or billowing clouds, we are in fact viewing God’s works of art, each one a witness to His glory.

Like a strong father lifting his child in his arms so that the child can better see the scenery in the distance, God also uses the beautiful sights of nature to raise our vision so that we see His power and creativity. It is not only a visual delight but nourishment for the soul.

A sister named Susan shared her experience of drawing near to God in nature. Once, walking in the countryside, she suddenly met a startling thunderstorm. Though at first she was afraid, when she stopped, listened carefully to the thunder and watched the lightning cross the sky, she realized it was a display of God’s power and glory. The experience made her more reverent toward God and deepened her understanding of His unlimited power.

Dear family, let us also learn to look for God’s glory in daily life. Whether a delicately designed flower or a vast ocean, every place is full of God’s fingerprints. This natural beauty not only reminds us of God’s existence but is proof of His love for us.
ah: Psalm 19:1 reminds us that the beauty and greatness of nature are witnesses to God’s glory. Here are several concrete ways we can experience God’s glory in daily life:
a: Observe nature

Plan time to go outdoors, whether a city park or a forest in the countryside, and observe the sky, plants, water, and animals. Appreciate the beauty of each part of nature and thank God for the wonder of His creation.
Stargazing
Join astronomy events or observe the stars and planets yourself, using a telescope or visiting an observatory, to learn more about the universe and grow in reverence for the God who created it.
Photography
Use a camera or phone to record beautiful moments in nature, such as sunrise, sunset, and starry skies, and share the photos so that more people sense God’s glory.
Environmental practice
Take an active part in environmental activities such as recycling and reducing plastic use, caring for the earth we live on, so that God’s creation continues to show His glory.
Educate and share
Introduce the wonders of nature to children and those around you, and through educational activities or group sharing guide them to know and care for God’s creation.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for displaying Your glory in the heavens and the expanse. When we see these beautiful sights, our hearts are reminded how great and almighty You are. Help us to care for this created world with practical action, so that our way of life reflects respect and gratitude for Your creation. Make us channels that pass on Your glory, so that more people know You as the ruler of the universe. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. As you enjoy God’s works in heaven and on earth, may you always remember His greatness and glory. Amen!

v: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
b: This verse inspires us to think about how God’s greatness and glory far exceed everything we see in daily life. When we feel confused or lost, this verse reminds us that God’s existence and power go beyond all our problems and challenges.

It is like a climber standing on a mountaintop for the first time, the view before him so vast that it takes his breath away. This picture helps us understand that when we look to God from the high points of our lives, we can see His glory and greatness more clearly.

A brother named Minghan once shared his testimony. In the hardest moment of his life, he climbed a high mountain seeking release. When he reached the top and saw the night sky full of stars, he deeply felt God’s glory and comfort. At that moment he realized that however hard life is, God’s glory and love always stand above everything.

Dear family, when life makes you weary, look up to the God who is high above all nations and whose glory is above the heavens. He is not only our Creator but our help and guide in every stage of life.
ah: Psalm 113:4 shows that the LORD’s glory is not only above all nations but higher than the heavens. This brings us the following concrete guidelines for action in life:
a: Exalt God’s name
In our daily conversation and communication, often mention God’s greatness and goodness, whether through social media, in our families, or in the workplace.
Take part in worship and praise
Take an active part in the church’s worship gatherings, singing of God’s glory with voice and heart, so that our praise reaches God’s throne like fragrance.
Teach and share
In group meetings or family fellowship, share about God’s glory and miracles, encouraging one another to know God’s greatness more deeply.
Personal meditation and prayer
Spend time each day in personal devotions, meditating on God’s Word and looking to God’s glory in prayer, asking Him to reveal this glory in our lives.
Do good to show God’s glory
By serving the community, helping those in need, and practicing Christian love in daily life, show God’s glory through practical action.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, Your glory is above all nations and higher than the heavens. Help us to see Your glory every day, and to reflect Your glory in our words, conduct, and thoughts. May our lives be a witness to Your glory, so that more people come to know Your greatness and glory by seeing our lives. Help us to follow Your will each day and show Your glory to the world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God’s glory, which is above all, in every day of your life, and find strength and peace in it. Amen!

v: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.
b: Today's verse reminds us that God's glory is everywhere, far beyond everything around us. When we look up at the mountains and gaze into the wide sky, these magnificent sights bear witness to His glory. Through the beauty of nature, we can sense the greatness and power of the Lord who made them.

Imagine a strong father lifting his child up so that the child can be closer to the sky and see the beautiful view far away. God leads us in the same way, letting us come to know Him better through all the good things in our lives and feel His glory.

A sister named Amy once shared her testimony. On a trip, she climbed a high mountain, and as she stood on the summit, the boundless scenery around her made her deeply feel God's glory and greatness. In that moment she understood more deeply what the psalm means by “Let your glory be above all the earth.” That experience made her faith firmer and made her long all the more for an intimate relationship with God.
This is our God, One who is above all things, who displays His glory on the mountaintops and in the deep valleys. Wherever we are, His glory is above us, guiding us forward.
ah: Psalm 108:5 tells us that God is exalted above the heavens and His glory is above all the earth. This verse reminds us that in every circumstance we should recognize God's supremacy and show forth His glory through our actions. In daily life, we can put this verse into practice in the following ways:
a: Daily Worship and Prayer
Set aside time each morning and evening to worship and pray, thanking God for His greatness and grace, so that our hearts are always connected to His glory.
Witness to God's Works
When talking with friends, family, and coworkers, share the wonderful things God has done and the blessings He has given in your life, so that more people may know His glory.
Service and Giving
Take part in church and community service, giving your time and resources to help those in need, showing God's love and glory through action.
Create Something Beautiful
Whether at work, in your studies, or in family life, do your best and create something beautiful, reflecting God's creativity and glory.
Praise God Through Nature
Experience and praise the beauty of God's creation in nature, whether flowers and trees or mountains and seas, praising His glory by appreciating the beauty of the natural world.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, You are exalted above the heavens, and Your glory is above all the earth. We thank You for Your boundless love and grace. Help us to show forth Your glory every day through worship, witness, service, and creativity. May our lives be a testimony to Your glory, so that more people may see Your greatness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you witness and feel God's glory in every corner of your life. Amen!

v: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.
b: This passage reveals a basic truth: God's glory fills the universe, from the heights of heaven to the earth beneath our feet. In our daily lives, every moment is an opportunity to receive and reflect this glory.

When the sun slowly rises at dawn and the horizon is gradually painted with gold and fiery red, this is not only a wonder of nature but also a display of God's glory. Such natural beauty is like a painting, reminding us how great God's glory is.

A sister once shared how, after walking a difficult road, she found God's comfort and glory in nature. One day she walked alone by the sea, looking at the boundless ocean and the wide sky, and she felt that though she was small, she was deeply loved and valued by God. Every crashing wave seemed to be God telling her, in the language of nature, that His glory and love are everywhere.
Dear family, wherever you are, you can see God's glory. Whether in the stars of the night sky, the splendor of the sunrise, or every detail of your life, you can find the traces of His hand.
ah: Psalm 148:13 reminds us that the Lord's name is exalted and His glory is above earth and heaven. To put this verse into practice in daily life, we can take the following steps:
a: Daily Praise
Set a daily time for praise, whether through singing, prayer, or reading Scripture, and make praise a daily habit.
Creative Praise
If you have a talent for writing songs or composing music, try creating works that reflect God's glory and share them with others.
Observing Nature
Spend time walking or observing in nature, such as watching a sunrise or sunset, and in those moments meditate on God's creation and sense His glory.
Teaching and Sharing
At family gatherings or in small groups, share Scripture about God's glory to deepen one another's understanding and knowledge of it.
Social Media
Post about God's glory and creation on social media, spreading His glory in a modern way.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for showing Your glory in every detail of our lives. Help us witness Your glory every day through praise, creativity, observing nature, and sharing. May our lives, words, and actions display Your glory, so that more people come to know Your greatness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see God's glory in your life and find joy and peace in that glory. Amen!

v: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—
b: This verse reveals God's holy promise that His glory will spread over all the earth. It is not only a declaration of His limitless power but also a comfort to us, reminding us that wherever we are, God's glory is all around us.

Picture yourself walking in the countryside, surrounded by rolling mountains and open fields. Every inch of this land, whether high mountain or low valley, is bathed in God's glory. This scene is not only beautiful; it also symbolizes God's care for, and sovereignty over, all of creation.

A sister named Alice once shared her testimony. During an extremely difficult period of her life, she went on a hike, seeking peace of heart as she walked. Standing on the mountaintop, looking out over the boundless view, she felt a transcendent peace, and she knew that this is a peace one can feel only when one recognizes that God's glory reaches every place.

Dear family, whenever we feel lonely or doubtful, let us remember how God's glory fills every corner, even the very ground on which we stand. God is not far away in the distance; through His creation He is with us every day.
ah: In Numbers 14:21 God declares, “But indeed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with Yahweh's glory.” This is a powerful declaration, reminding us that God's glory is everywhere and calling us, as His people, to display this glory in our lives. Here are some practical steps to help us live out this declaration in daily life:
a: Actively Bear Witness
Let others see God's love and power through our words and actions. Whether by helping those in need or by holding on to our faith in hard times, we can show God's glory.
Create Harmonious Communities
Work to create an environment of harmony and love in your family, workplace, or church. When we love one another, bear with one another, and forgive, we are in fact bringing about God's glory.
Care for the Environment
Cherish the earth God created, and show respect for the glory of His creation through simple actions such as recycling and saving energy and water.
Take Part in Church and Community Service
By serving others we can bring God's glory to more people. This might be working at a food bank, joining the church's charity activities, or volunteering in the community.
Continued Spiritual Growth
Through prayer, Bible reading, and fellowship, let our spiritual lives be enriched so that we can better reflect God's glory in daily life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for declaring that Your glory will fill all the earth. Give us wisdom and strength to display Your glory in every area of daily life. Help us, through witness, harmonious living, caring for the environment, active community service, and spiritual growth, to let Your glory be seen. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see and experience God's glory, and may that glory become strength and guidance in your life. Amen!

v: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
b: This verse is full of praise and hope for God's glory. It encourages us to realize that God's glory is not only in heaven but is meant to fill the whole earth. God's glory is like the rays of sunrise, present everywhere and shining on everything.

It is like the scene at dawn: when the first ray of sunlight breaks across the sky, the light gradually spreads over the whole land. So it is with God's glory, which spreads from the highest courts of heaven until it fills every corner of our lives. This is not only a visual wonder but a spiritual picture, reminding us that God's presence is everywhere.

A brother named Eric once shared his experience of feeling God's glory in nature. On a mountain hike, standing on the summit and gazing into the distance, surrounded by magnificent scenery, he deeply felt that God's glory is not confined to the church altar but fills the whole world. This made him all the more convinced that, wherever we are in daily life, God's glory is around us.

Dear family, whether we are going through hardship or joy, let us not forget to look up to that eternal light and remember that God's glory has already filled the earth. In our hearts, in our families, in our communities, even in the most distant places, His presence and protection are there.
dc:
In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May your life be filled with God's glory, and may you find unchanging joy and peace in that glory. Amen!
663 Soul Snack Action Poem, Psalm 72:19: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and amen.

v: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
b: This verse tells us that God's salvation is closely tied to those who fear Him, and that because of such people, glory will dwell in our land. It makes us think about how we can live out this kind of reverence in daily life, so that God's glory is made manifest around us.

A farmer carefully tends his field, knowing that every seed needs sunshine, water, and nutrients to grow. Fearing God is like a farmer tending his field: it is essential for our spiritual growth. When our hearts hold reverence and we follow His teaching, our lives will bear abundant fruit, and that fruit is the evidence of God's glory appearing among us.

A brother named Joseph faced many challenges in life, but he always kept trusting God and sought His guidance in every difficulty. Once he lost his job, but he did not give up his faith; instead he devoted himself even more to prayer and worship while actively looking for new opportunities. In the end he found a better job, and through this experience his family and friends saw what God had done in his life. This is a true example of God's glory appearing on earth.

Dear family, in daily life, whatever difficulties we meet, let us keep our reverence for God. In this way we will not only experience His salvation but also let His glory be seen in our lives, becoming a blessing and a testimony to others.
ah: Psalm 85:9 emphasizes that fearing God is closely linked to His salvation and allows His glory to dwell among us. It is a reminder that through our conduct and life of faith we can bring God's glory to our communities and the world. Here are concrete ways to put this verse into practice:
a: Start a Faith-Sharing Group

Organize a group at home or work to share regularly about your personal faith journeys and testimonies. This not only deepens mutual understanding but also lets God's glory flow naturally through everyday conversation.
Launch a Community Art Project

Use art as a bridge for conveying faith, for example by creating a mural or joining a public art installation. Such works can express God's creation and grace in a themed way, letting the whole community feel His glory.
Take Environmental Action

By caring for God's creation, the earth, through actions such as cleaning up the neighborhood and planting trees, express reverence and gratitude for what He made. This too is a way of letting God's glory appear on earth.
Host Talks on Faith and Science

Hold lectures or seminars at church or in the community exploring the harmony between scientific discovery and biblical truth. This can help people see that God's glory is not limited to the spiritual realm but is also displayed in the physical world we live in.
Develop Digital Gospel Platforms
Use modern technology, such as websites, apps, or social media platforms, to share the gospel and spiritual teaching, bringing God's glory to the digital world and to the younger generation.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us the chance to show Your glory in creative ways. Guide us so that at home, at work, in our communities, and even in the digital world, we may reflect Your glory. Help us show Your love and glory to those around us through all kinds of practical actions. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you experience God's salvation every day of your life, and may His glory be revealed on this earth through you. Amen!

v: Behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east. His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth was illuminated with his glory.
b: His voice was like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with his glory.

This verse lets us see how mighty and ever-present God's glory is. His voice is like the sound of many waters, full of majesty and power, and His glory makes the earth shine. It reminds us that God's presence and works are the light and guidance of our lives. Whatever difficulties or challenges we face, His glory can always bring us hope and strength.

Think of a lighthouse keeper who watches over the coastline in the dark of night. The lighthouse beam guides lost ships and keeps them from danger. God's glory is like the light of that lighthouse, guiding us onto the right path and away from the dangers and confusion of life.

A brother named Xin'en once fell into hardship: unemployment, health problems, and family conflict left him feeling lost and helpless. In that dark time he began to seek God, reading Scripture and praying often, and attending church gatherings. In one prayer he deeply felt God's presence and glory, and in that moment his heart was lit up and filled with strength and hope. Soon afterward he found a new job, and his family relationships gradually returned to harmony. His life was changed by God's glory, which lit up every step he took.

Dear family, when we feel lost and helpless, let us not forget to look up to God's glory. His light will lead us out of the darkness into a bright future. Let us hold fast to our faith in daily life and pray often, letting God's glorious light shine on our hearts and our paths.
ah: Ezekiel 43:2 reminds us how God's glory lights up this world. We can bring this glory into our lives in the following practical ways
a: Spread Light in the Community

Take an active part in community service, such as helping the elderly, cleaning up the neighborhood, or organizing learning activities for children. These are ways to let God's glory shine on others through your actions.
Show Integrity at Work
Whatever your work environment, make every decision and take every action with honesty, fairness, and love, so that your professional conduct reflects God's glory.
Build a Habit of Prayer at Home
Pray regularly together with your family, seeking God's guidance and glory, so that your home becomes a refuge of His glory.
Personal Spiritual Cultivation
Through daily meditation on Scripture and prayer, let God's word become the guide of your everyday life.
Express Faith Through the Arts
Create or support Christian art, such as music, painting, or writing, and use it to present God's glory to a wider audience.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, please help our lives, our work, and our families become a light of Your glory. Let us be carriers of Your glory, lighting up the environment around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God's glorious light always shine on your life, bringing you strength and hope. Amen!​⬤

v: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and the LORD’s glory has risen on you!
b: This verse encourages us to arise and shine even in dark times, because God's light and glory have come among us. Whatever difficulties we face, God's glory will lead us out of the darkness and into the light.

It is like a gardener who, after a long winter, sees the first ray of spring light and is filled with hope and joy. God's light is like that spring light, driving away the cold and the dark and bringing new life and hope.

A brother named David once fell into hardship, facing financial pressure, trouble at work, and problems at home. In that dark time he began to seek God, reading Scripture and praying every morning, asking for God's guidance and strength. One morning in prayer he sensed God's presence and light, and his heart was filled with peace and strength. After that he began to look actively for ways to solve his problems, and he felt God leading him step by step. A few months later his finances improved, there was a new breakthrough at work, and his family relationships became more harmonious. His life became full of hope and strength through God's glorious light.

Dear family, whatever challenges we face, let us remember that God's light has come, and His glory will shine on us and lead us out of the darkness. Let us arise and shine, for God's glory is among us.
ah: Isaiah 60:1 reminds us that God's glory has come and that we are called to shine. This verse encourages us to seek and display God's glory in our daily lives. Here is concrete guidance on how to put this holy calling into practice every day:
a: Take Part Actively in Prayer Meetings and Gatherings
Join your church's prayer meetings regularly, and let God's Spirit fill your life and become the wellspring of your daily conduct.
Serve the Community
Look for opportunities to serve in your community, whether helping the elderly, joining a neighborhood cleanup, or supporting charity events, so that your actions reflect God's love and glory.
Witness in Daily Life
Through everyday conversation and conduct, such as honesty, patience, and kindness, testify to the reality of your faith, letting people see how the Lord's glory shines upon you.
Culture and the Arts
If you are gifted in art or writing, create works that reflect your faith, and through them convey and spread God's light and glory.
Education and Training
Commit yourself to your own spiritual growth and that of others: join a Bible study group or hold workshops that teach others how to live out their faith and develop the potential God has given them.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for Your glory and guidance in our lives. Grant us strength and wisdom so that we can shine in our daily lives and be witnesses to Your glory. May all the glory be Yours. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God's light always shine on your life, bringing you endless hope and strength. Amen!

v: Then the Spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me the voice of a great rushing, saying, “Blessed be the LORD’s glory from his place.”
b: This verse reminds us that God's glory is everywhere, and that wherever we are we can witness His greatness and majesty. When our hearts feel lost or confused, remember that God's glory can bring us guidance and strength.

It is like a painter creating a beautiful painting: when sunlight falls on the canvas, the colors become vivid and alive. Our lives are the same. When we let God's glory shine into our hearts, every corner of life becomes full of meaning and radiance.

A sister named Sally, after a great setback in her career, felt that the road of her life was dark. She decided to rise early each morning and pray quietly in the park. Once, during prayer, she suddenly sensed God's presence, and warmth and light filled her heart. From that day Sally began to re-examine her life. She saw the glory God revealed in her difficulties and decided to face her challenges with a completely new attitude. She found a job that suited her, and in it she made a great impact. Her life was completely changed by feeling God's glory.

Dear family, when we face the challenges of life, remember to look up to God's glory, and His light will lead us out of our difficulties. In every hard moment, let us bless God's glory, for He is our strength and guide.
ah: Ezekiel 3:12 reminds us that the glory of the Lord is awe-inspiring and overwhelming, and should be praised by us. Here are concrete ways we can honor God's glory in daily life:
a: Grow in Spiritual Awareness
Set particular moments each day to sense and respond to God's glory. It could be morning meditation, a midday prayer break, or evening thanksgiving.
Hold Praise Gatherings
With family and friends, hold praise and worship gatherings at home regularly, experiencing God's glory together through music and prayer.
Take Part in Church Service
Take an active part in church ministry, especially those that directly express God's glory, such as spreading the gospel and acts of love.
Express Praise Through Art
Express praise for God's glory through painting, writing, or music, and share these works with others to pass on God's glory.
Teach and Share
In small groups or family gatherings, share experiences and testimonies about God's glory, encouraging one another to seek and reflect His glory in daily life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the immeasurable glory You show in our lives. Help us every day to seek and respond to Your glory with reverent hearts, and to express praise to You in our actions and words. Grant us courage and wisdom to shine for Your glory in the world. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May God's glory always be with you, bringing you endless peace and strength. Amen!

v: In the morning, you shall see the LORD’s glory; because he hears your murmurings against the LORD. Who are we, that you murmur against us?”
b: This verse reminds us that God not only hears our cries and complaints but also reveals His glory in our lives. When we are in difficulty and feel disappointed or resentful, God still cares for us and is willing to use His glory to transform our situation.

It is like a dark night: when the first ray of dawn appears, the whole world becomes bright. God's glory is like this dawn, able to drive away the darkness in our lives and bring hope and a new beginning.

A brother named Xinhua once suffered a major setback in his career. He was deeply discouraged and even voiced many complaints to God. One morning he was walking by the river, thinking about the troubles of his life. Suddenly he saw the rising sun slowly come up over the horizon, sunlight spilling over the land, bringing boundless light and warmth. In that moment Xinhua deeply felt God's presence and glory. He understood that God had heard his complaints and, through this beautiful morning light, had shown him His love and power. From that day Xinhua decided to change his attitude: no longer complaining, but trusting God and welcoming new challenges.

Dear family, when we meet difficulties in life, remember that God's glory is always near us. Let us learn, every morning, to look forward to seeing God's glory, for He hears our cries and is willing to light our path with His brightness.
ah: Exodus 16:7 reminds us that the glory of the Lord is found in His care for us and His promises. Even amid complaining and discontent, God's grace and glory are still shown to us. We can experience God's glory in daily life through the following practical ways:
a: Reflection and Gratitude

Set aside a specific time each day to reflect on what God has done in your life. Write down the grace you sense each day; this will help shift your focus from your difficulties and strengthen a thankful heart.
Turn Complaints into Prayer
When you feel dissatisfied or tempted to complain, try turning those feelings into prayer. Bring your worries and confusion before God and seek His guidance and peace.
Share Your Testimony with Others
Share with family, friends, or your church fellowship how you have experienced God's glory and His answers. This not only encourages others but also deepens your own knowledge of His glory.
Service and Giving
Take an active part in church and community service. When we give of ourselves in service, we not only practice Christ's love but also witness God's glory in the lives of others.
Regular Spiritual Disciplines
Practices such as fasting and silent prayer help you connect more deeply with God and experience His presence and glory.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for continually showing Your glory in our lives. Even when we complain and are discontent, You still generously show us Your love and mercy. Help us learn gratitude and turn our discontent into seeking You. May we see Your glory every day of our lives, and make Your name known through service and testimony. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you see God's glory every morning, and find courage and hope in that glory. Amen!

v: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.
b: This verse reminds us that God's kingdom is full of majesty and glory, and that His mighty acts are worth testifying to the world. When we receive God's grace and power, we have a responsibility to share with those around us the wonderful things God has done in our lives.

We are like a bright lighthouse that guides lost ships through the night to a safe harbor. Each of us should be such a lighthouse, bearing witness to God's glory with our lives and guiding others toward light and peace.

A brother named Paul had a life full of God's wonderful works. Paul had once been a successful entrepreneur, but in an economic crisis he lost all his property and even fell into deep despair. Yet in his darkest hour he turned to God and regained faith and hope. Paul began to serve actively in the church, and with his testimony he encouraged countless people in difficulty. He often said, “God's kingdom is full of glory, and His mighty acts are displayed in our lives. As long as we are willing to trust Him, miracles will happen.”

Dear family, let us also be like Paul, bearing witness with our lives to God's mighty acts and proclaiming the majestic glory of His kingdom. Whatever difficulties we face, God's glory can shine in our lives, bringing endless hope and peace to us and to those around us.
ah: Psalm 145:12 reminds us to share the majesty and glory of God's kingdom. We can show God's mighty power and the glory of His kingdom in daily life in the following ways.
a: Teaching and Sharing
In your church or community, take an active part in, or lead, studies and sharing about the teaching of God's kingdom. This can be done by forming study groups or giving testimonies in worship.
Spreading the Word on Social Media
Use social media platforms to share teaching about God and your personal testimony, so that more people can learn about the glory of His kingdom through modern means of communication.
Service and Care
Take part in or start service projects, such as food banks, clothing donations, or support for the elderly, showing the love and glory of God's kingdom through action.
Create Art
Create or support Christian art and cultural works, such as music, paintings, and poetry, expressing your understanding and praise of God's kingdom through art.
Dialogue and Communication
In everyday conversation with others, whether at work or at home, show Christian values and character as a representative of the majesty of God's kingdom.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us such a great opportunity to spread the glory of Your kingdom in daily life through teaching, social media, service, art, and everyday conversation. Guide our every step, and let our lives and actions be a reflection of Your glory. Let us display Your glorious light in every circumstance. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!​⬤
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you witness God's mighty acts every day, and share the majestic glory of His kingdom with more people. Amen!

v: everyone who is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yes, whom I have made.’”
b: This verse reminds us that everyone called a child of God was created to display God's glory. Our existence is not mere chance but has a deep purpose and meaning. God has a wonderful plan for each of our lives, and the heart of that plan is that we reflect His glory in the world.

It is like an artist carefully creating a painting, in which every stroke is full of meaning and effort. In the same way, God has invested boundless love and wisdom in our lives, and He hopes that we will become witnesses to His glory.

A brother named Li Ming has a life that bears witness to the truth of this verse. Li Ming was an ordinary worker, but at work he always kept integrity, diligence, and love, and whatever difficulties he met, he faced them with a thankful heart. He often helped those around him in need and testified to God's love and glory with his life. Once his company faced the crisis of closing down, and many people chose to leave, but Li Ming stayed at his post and encouraged his colleagues to work together. In the end the company got through the hard times, and because of his perseverance and faith Li Ming was promoted to supervisor. His life not only changed himself but also influenced many people around him, letting them see God's glory revealed in him.
Dear family, let us remember that each one of us was created for God's glory. Whatever our status or occupation, through love, integrity, and perseverance we can let God's glory be seen in our lives.
ah: Isaiah 43:7 teaches us that we were created for God's glory, so our lives and conduct should reflect this mission.
a: Affirming Your Identity
Spend time each day meditating on the fact that you were created by God and exist for His glory. This is not only the foundation of self-knowledge but also the source of self-respect and self-worth.
A Sense of Purpose in Life
Find opportunities to serve God in your career and daily life. Whether you are a doctor, a teacher, or a homemaker, look for ways to offer your work and family life for God's glory.
Serve in the Church and Community
Take an active part in church service and community volunteer work, showing through your conduct that you live for God's glory.
Spiritual Growth and Education
Join Bible study, prayer meetings, and spiritual retreats. These are ways to deepen your knowledge of God's will and calling, and help you live out His glory better.
The Importance of Sharing Your Faith
Through personal testimony and sharing the gospel, help more people realize that they too were created for God's glory, encouraging them to live out their own mission and purpose.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for creating us according to Your image and for Your glory. Help us to recognize our identity and the purpose of our lives, so that every action and decision of daily life may honor You. Guide us to serve actively in the church and community, and through spiritual growth deepen our understanding of Your will. Finally, grant us courage to share this grace with others, so that more lives may know they were born for Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen!
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you display God's glory in your life every day, and testify with your life to His greatness and lovingkindness. Amen!​

v: Joshua said to the people, “You can’t serve the LORD, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.
b: “You can't serve Yahweh, for he is a holy God. He is a jealous God. He will not forgive your disobedience nor your sins.”

This passage is Joshua's warning to the people of Israel. He reminds us that the Lord is a holy God, who has absolute intolerance for sin and cannot tolerate any form of rebellion. This holiness calls us into a relationship of total commitment with God, and calls our lives to be blameless before Him.

It is like a person who is determined to keep his clothes white and clean: he must avoid walking through mud. In the same way, when we recognize God's holiness, we must keep our hearts pure at all times and stay away from everything that would defile our souls.

A brother named Zhang Wei faced many trials of moral choice in his life. Once he had a chance to earn a considerable sum of money through improper means. But Zhang Wei remembered this verse and felt God's reminder in his heart, so he chose to give up the opportunity. Although it meant financial pressure in the short term, he believed that keeping a pure heart was more important than temporary wealth. In the end God blessed his faith: a few months later he got a better job, his income steadily increased, and his life was filled with peace and joy because of this choice.

Zhang Wei's story shows us that God's holiness calls us to stay alert at all times and to choose the path of righteousness. When we are willing to give up temptations that seem attractive and choose to obey God's holiness, He will surely give us even greater blessings.

Dear family, let us remember that the Lord is a holy God, and we cannot take the consequences of sin lightly. In every decision, may we choose the path of righteousness, letting our lives be vessels of God's holiness that honor His name.
ah: This verse reminds us that God is holy and is jealous against sin. So in daily life we should be more watchful and avoid any behavior that leads us away from the way of God's holiness. We can put this truth into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions
a: Daily Devotional Time
Set a fixed time to read and meditate on God's word each day, letting God's holiness continually remind us to keep our hearts pure.
Examine Your Heart
At the end of each day, spend a few minutes reflecting on your words and actions that day, to see whether anything offended God's holiness, and confess and repent before Him.
Stay Away from Temptation
Avoid situations or places that could lead to sin, and let your living environment be closer to God's holiness.
Walk with the Holy
Make friends who fear God, encourage one another, and help one another hold fast on the road of pursuing holiness.
Witness in Service
Take part in church ministry or community service, letting your conduct reflect respect for God's holiness and influence those around you toward His holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, You are a holy God. Help us to keep a holy heart in our daily lives and stay far from all sin. May our words and conduct reflect Your holiness and bear a good witness for You in this generation. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you always remember God's holiness when you face choices in life, choose to obey His will, and receive heavenly blessings because of it. Amen!

v: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
b: This verse reminds us that holiness is not only God's call to us but also a pursuit that cannot be absent from our lives. The demand for holiness is not because we ourselves are able to become perfect, but because our God is holy, and He wants His people to reflect His character. This is not merely a moral requirement but a confirmation of spiritual identity. When we pursue holiness, we are living out in daily life a way that belongs to God.

It is like a clear mirror, which can reflect the outside scene clearly only if it is wiped often. In the same way, our hearts need constant self-examination and cleansing, so that we can truly reflect God's glory and holiness.

A sister named Chen Lifang faced great pressure and temptation at work. In her company, many people compromised on morality and integrity in pursuit of profit and promotion. Yet Lifang always held fast to purity of heart, believing that only by being pure and upright before God could she truly obtain lasting peace and joy. Once the company asked employees to make some dishonest changes to a contract, which put Lifang in a dilemma.

She knew that refusing might cost her the job, but she knew even more that compromise would mean turning her back on the truth she believed. In the end she chose to hold fast to integrity. Although her decision cost her the chance of promotion in the short term, the peace in her heart was priceless. A few years later, because of Lifang's integrity, the company built a good reputation in the industry, and her perseverance also won her greater respect and greater blessing.

Lifang's testimony tells us that when we choose the path of holiness, we may seem foolish or out of step in the eyes of the world, but our God is faithful and will not let us down. His grace will grow richer along with our choices, so that we may stand firm in His glory.

Dear family, let us remember that our God is holy, and He calls us to pursue holiness, not only in outward conduct but in the depths of our hearts. May our lives, in both good times and bad, hold fast to this holiness that belongs to God, and let His glory be shown through our lives.
ah: This verse reminds us that because God is holy, we too should pursue holiness in our lives. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Purify Your Living Space

Each week pick one corner of your home or your office desk to tidy and clean. This is not only literal cleaning but a symbol of asking God in our hearts for cleansing, creating a space that better reflects God's holiness.
Clean Up Your Social Media
Once a month, clean up your social media: choose to block content that brings negative emotions or provokes unholy thoughts, and follow accounts that encourage and uplift your spiritual growth.
A Daily Moment of Stillness

Set aside five minutes every day, without your phone and without doing anything, simply to be silent before God, reflect on the state of your heart, and ask Him to cleanse your heart and keep your spirit holy.
A Wearable Reminder
Choose a special piece of clothing or an accessory, such as a bracelet with a Bible verse, so that whenever you see or touch it you remind yourself to live a holy life in word, deed, and thought.
A Holy Mealtime Plan

Plan one meal each week when the whole family eats together, giving thanks and discussing a theme about holiness, whether sharing experiences or discussing a figure from the Bible, letting thoughts of holiness permeate daily life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding us to pursue holiness in everything. Help us to put this holiness into practice in the details of life, whether in cleaning our surroundings, reflecting in silence, or witnessing to Your holiness in word and deed. May our lives be a display of Your glory. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, with a holy heart and holy conduct, honor our God every day of your life and keep growing in His grace. Amen!

v: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”
b: “How long, holy and true Lord, will You not judge those who dwell on the earth and avenge our blood?”

This verse reminds us that no matter how much injustice and suffering we experience in this world, our Lord is always holy and true. He sees every tear and hears every cry, and His judgment is just and impartial. In this imperfect world, sin and injustice often seem to prevail, but we can be sure that final judgment and justice are in the hands of our holy Lord, and at the right time He will vindicate His people.

It is like a judge with a heart for justice. Although a case may take a long time to investigate and try, in the end he will deliver a fair verdict according to the truth. In the same way, our Lord will not overlook anyone who has been wronged. His judgment may seem delayed to us, but behind that delay are God's wisdom and God's timetable.

A brother named Zhang Hua was once treated unfairly at work. Because he refused to take part in improper business practices, he was shunned and falsely accused by his colleagues. Zhang Hua felt extreme pain and helplessness, but he did not lose faith. Every day in prayer he poured out his heart to God, asking Him to reveal His justice. A few months later, things unexpectedly turned around. The company carried out an internal review and found that the people who had accused him had in fact broken the rules. Zhang Hua was not only cleared but, because of his integrity, was promoted. He deeply realized that God's justice, though it sometimes seems to arrive late, does arrive in the end, and it is more perfect than we can imagine.

Zhang Hua's testimony tells us that in the face of injustice and suffering, we should learn to be patient and trust the holy and true Lord. His judgment is without error, and His timing is the best. As long as we keep trusting, final victory will be ours.

Dear family, let us remember that our Lord is holy and true, and He will vindicate His people. When we experience injustice and pain in this world, let us not lose heart, for our God sees everything, and at the best moment He will bring us justice.
ah: This verse reminds us that God is the holy and true Judge, and He will carry out justice at the right time. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Create a “Justice Notebook”: keep a “Justice Notebook” at home, recording your experiences and feelings each time you face injustice, and next to it write how you entrust the matter to God. This helps remind you continually to rely on God's justice.
Regularly Gather Stories of Social Justice
Each month, watch or read videos or books about social justice with family or friends, then discuss the justice in those stories and think about how to better reflect God's justice in your life.

Kind “anonymous letters”: when you notice someone being overlooked or treated unfairly, write an anonymous letter of encouragement or a thank-you card, encouraging them to hold on to what is right. This brings comfort and also shows that you value justice.
A Prayer Walk for Justice
Take a prayer walk in your neighborhood or city, praying for those who are treated unfairly and asking God's justice to be revealed, and think about how you can actually help others in those places.
Set Up a Family Justice Time

Choose a time each week to discuss with your family the unfairness in society today and pray together, seeking God's leading and the revealing of His justice. This can deepen the spiritual bond among family members.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You that You are the holy and true Lord, and that You will reveal justice in Your time. Help us to learn to rely on You when we face injustice, and to reflect Your justice in our lives through small actions. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, when you face injustice and challenges, always stand firm in faith and rely on the holy and true Lord. He will vindicate you and give you justice and peace. Amen!

v: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
b: This verse portrays the perfect image of our Lord Jesus Christ. He is the holy and spotless High Priest, far from all sin, and His holiness makes Him worthy to be our mediator, praying and interceding for us before God. Each of us needs such a Lord, because we often struggle in sin, and only He can cleanse us and bring us into God's holiness.

This reminds me of a doctor who has not only superb medical skill but also a selfless heart. However serious the illness, he treats every patient with confidence and love. Patients trust him not only because of his professional knowledge but because of his selfless, giving heart. In the same way, Jesus Christ as our High Priest not only has a holy and spotless character but also has boundless love to heal our souls, leading us into God's presence.

A sister named Liu Li, in the early days of her faith, felt deep guilt and self-reproach over the many offenses in her life, and always felt she was unworthy to stand before God. But as she came to know Jesus Christ, this holy High Priest, more deeply, she understood that His holiness is not meant to keep us away from Him, but that because of His holiness we may draw near to God and be cleansed. This truth brought Liu Li great comfort and freedom, enabling her to walk boldly into God's presence and enjoy His love and forgiveness.

Liu Li's experience tells us that when we feel unworthy and guilty, we should not draw away from God but come all the more before this holy High Priest, because He has already prepared a way of cleansing for us, so that we may come before God without fear.

Dear family, let us remember that Jesus Christ is our holy High Priest. His holiness has opened a way to God for us. Whatever our past, His precious blood can cleanse us, renew our strength, and bring us near to God.
ah: This verse reminds us that Jesus Christ is our holy High Priest, spotless and blameless, who intercedes for us. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A daily “Jesus Moment”: set aside a few minutes each day to be alone with Jesus, whether in prayer, meditation, or Bible reading, letting Jesus' holiness become part of your daily life and keeping your spiritual life clean.
A Holy Prayer Jar

Make a prayer jar. Write down the people or matters that need intercession, and after you pray for them, put the slip of paper into the jar, symbolizing that you have entrusted these matters to our holy High Priest.

A “Spotless Day” challenge: choose one day to try to keep your thoughts, words, and actions spotless, and record the challenges and experiences of that day. This will help you appreciate more deeply the holiness of Jesus in daily life.

Spiritual “cleansing”: once a month, do a spiritual clean-up. Review your life and check whether anything has led you away from God's standard of holiness, and give up those unholy habits or attitudes.
Offer a Meal

Choose one meal as a time of fasting and prayer, offering that meal to God and interceding for your family, friends, and community. Follow Christ's heart of intercession and let this moment become a time of intimate communion with God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us Jesus Christ as our holy High Priest. Help us to pursue holiness in daily life, so that in thought, word, and deed we reflect the holiness of Jesus. May our lives honor You and become channels of blessing to others. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, through this holy High Priest Jesus Christ, enjoy an intimate relationship with God every day of your life, and find peace and strength in His love. Amen!

v: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
b: This verse shows God's sovereignty and His insistence on holiness. God carries out justice in His holiness; His plans and works are all founded on His perfectly spotless holiness. When God declares His will, He acts not only according to His wisdom but also judges and apportions according to His holiness. This tells us that when we follow God, we too must walk in holiness, because that is the only way to walk with God.

It is like a craftsman with absolute standards, who carefully carves every piece he makes and never allows any flaw to appear. God is the same: He carves the standard of holiness into our lives, and He wants us to walk in His light, allowing no compromise or carelessness.

A brother named Wang Gang, faced with all kinds of temptations in life, chose to hold to the path of holiness. When the people around him gave up principles for short-term gain, Wang Gang firmly believed that only by obeying God's word could he truly have inner peace and joy. Once, at his company, he faced a very tempting business opportunity, but it required him to abandon his moral bottom line, and Wang Gang resolutely decided to give it up. In the end God opened a better road for him, which not only preserved his faith but also gave him even greater blessing.

Wang Gang's testimony helps us understand that when we choose to walk in holiness, we may meet all kinds of challenges and temptations, but God's holiness will become our protection and guide, letting us find true peace and joy in His will.
Dear family, let us remember that our God is holy, and He calls us to walk in His holiness. When we persist in acting in holiness, God's blessing and protection will surely come upon us.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's holiness contains His plans and blessings for us, and that He guides us at every step of our lives. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Daily Gratitude Card

Each morning write down one thing you are thankful to God for, and read it again before bed, thanking God for His guidance throughout the day. This helps you always remember God's plans and blessings in your life.
A Spiritual Map
Make a “spiritual map” of your spiritual growth, marking each important moment when God has guided you, and let this map become a tool for continual gratitude and for witnessing to God's holiness.
A Day on the Devotional Trail

Choose a suitable day to go with family or friends into nature for a silent walk, observing and appreciating the holiness in God's creation and His control over all things, and sensing His guidance in the natural world.

A “footprint” of faith: place a small sandbox in a corner of your home, and each time you experience God's guidance or blessing in prayer, leave a footprint in the sand, symbolizing each step you take under God's leading.
A Regular Reflection Meeting
Once a month, hold a reflection meeting with a spiritual partner or family, sharing how God has guided your life in the past period, and asking Him to keep leading and blessing you in the days ahead.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for guiding and blessing us in Your holiness. Help us see Your hand at work in our lives every day, and respond to You with grateful hearts. May our lives be a witness to Your holy plan. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
