dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold fast to holiness in your decisions every day, rely on God's strength, walk the bright road He has prepared, and receive abundant life. Amen!

v: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
b: This verse tells us that God's holiness and His promises are closely joined. When God swears by His holiness, He assures us that His word will never fail and His promises will surely be fulfilled. This means we can trust God's word completely, because His holiness never changes and is the foundation of His faithfulness.

It is like an honest merchant whose every promise is as good as gold; whatever difficulties he meets, he keeps his word. In the same way, God is such a faithful One, and each of His promises is built on His holy nature and will never be false.

A sister named Wang Siping had for many years prayed for the salvation of her family. Though she went through many disappointments and long waits, she always held firmly to God's promise. In the end, in God's time, her husband and children all turned to the Lord. Siping firmly believes that all of this came about because of God's faithfulness and His holy promise, and her faith was made even stronger by this testimony.

Siping's testimony reminds us that as we wait for God's promises to be fulfilled, we need patience and faith, because each of God's promises is built on the foundation of His holiness and will never fail.

Dear family, let us remember that God's holiness guarantees that His promises will surely be fulfilled. Whatever we are waiting for, as long as it is according to God's word, we can trust firmly, for He is faithful and unchanging.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's holiness and His promises are absolute and never change. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Holy Commitment

Make a spiritual commitment with family or friends, such as a fixed daily time for devotions, or taking responsibility for a particular ministry, and keep that commitment, motivated by God's holiness.
A Faithfulness Reminder

Set a reminder on your phone or calendar at a fixed time each day to remind yourself of God's promises, and think about how He has kept those promises in your life. This will help you always remember God's faithfulness.
A Promise Box

Make a promise box. Write down the promises of God that you read in the Bible and put them in the box. When you feel discouraged or in difficulty, draw one out at random to remind yourself that God's faithfulness never changes.
A Faith Necklace
Choose a necklace or bracelet as a reminder. Whenever you feel low, touch it and meditate on God's promises, reminding yourself that God's faithfulness is the foundation of our faith.
A Spiritual Covenant Keeper
Choose a spiritual partner, and commit to remind and encourage each other at least once a week, share God's faithfulness in each other's lives, and pray together, keeping the vows made to God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for leading us with Your holy promises; Your promises never change. Help us to keep our vows to You in life and often remind ourselves that You are a faithful God. May we be people who keep covenant before You, witnessing to Your holiness and truth. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you, in every expectation and hope, firmly trust God's holy promises, and through His faithfulness receive peace and strength of heart. Amen!

v: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
b: This verse reminds us that as Christians we are not only a redeemed people but also a holy priesthood chosen to serve God. This means that every action of our daily lives can become an offering to God. Whether prayer, worship, serving others, or proclaiming the gospel, these are our duties as a holy priesthood.

It is like a musician carefully tuning every note to ensure the harmony and perfection of the whole piece. Each small adjustment seems insignificant, yet it affects the whole performance. In the same way, each of our acts of service and worship, offered to God with a holy heart, will be accepted before Him and become a spiritual sacrifice that glorifies Him.

A brother named Zhang Zhiming has served in the church for many years. Whether cleaning the sanctuary or leading worship, he approaches it with a devout and holy attitude. He believes that every small act of service is an offering to God, and that God values it. This attitude has helped him keep growing in service, and the fellowship he leads has become more harmonious and strong because of his example.
Zhang Zhiming's testimony tells us that when we serve God with a holy heart, our lives become a spiritual sacrifice He accepts, and in the process we draw closer to Him.

Dear family, let us remember that we are a holy priesthood chosen by God, and that every action and every act of service can become an offering to Him. May we serve Him every day with a holy heart and glorify His name.
ah: This verse reminds us that each of us is called to be a holy priest, offering everything we are to God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Family Altar

Set up a simple “family altar” at home, and each night pray and read Scripture together with your family before this altar, offering each day's challenges and thanksgivings to God. This not only strengthens the spiritual bond of the family but also brings God's holiness into the home.
A Spiritual Calendar

Mark spiritually important days on your calendar, such as days of fasting and prayer or days of spiritual renewal, to remind yourself to devote time especially to God on those days, for deeper devotion and reflection.
An Intercession Network

Join or organize a small prayer group that regularly prays for one another and for needs in the church. Through the ministry of intercession, practice the role of a holy priest and bring each other's needs before God.
Thankful Handcrafts

Make thank-you cards or small handcrafts. After finishing each one, write on it something you are thankful to God for, and place it in a visible spot at home, symbolizing that you offer each accomplishment to God.
Sharing Your Devotions

Once a week, share your recent devotional insights or spiritual experiences with friends or family around you. By sharing and encouraging others, practice the ministry of a holy priest, so that more people can feel God's grace and guidance.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to be a holy priesthood and to offer our lives to You. Help us live out this calling in daily life through prayer, gratitude, and service. May our lives be an offering that pleases You and glorifies Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you sense God's presence in every act of service, and in His love become a holy priest, offering your life as a sacrifice He accepts. Amen!

v: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.
b: This verse gives us an important identity as Christians: we are called a holy nation, a people specially chosen by God. This is not merely a title but a holy mission. We were called out of darkness into God's light in order to proclaim God's excellencies and bear witness to His love and power. So everything we say and do should reflect this identity and let the people around us see God's radiance.

It is like an ambassador of a country, whose words and conduct represent not only himself but also his nation. In the same way, as members of a holy nation, we should let people see God's glory and excellence through us.

A brother named Zhou Wei often faced doubts and challenges from colleagues at work, but he always responded with love and honesty and never compromised with improper conduct. Once he was isolated for refusing to take part in an immoral scheme, but he still held to his integrity. In the end his superior discovered the truth, deeply admired his integrity, and praised him publicly in a meeting. This not only set an example for him among his colleagues but also gave people a new view of Christians.
Zhou Wei's testimony tells us that when we live out a holy life, we become witnesses of God's kingdom, and our lives can be a bridge for others to know God.

Dear family, let us remember that we are God's people, a holy nation. Everything we say and do should proclaim the God who called us out of darkness into light, so that His name is glorified in our lives.
ah: This verse reminds us that we were chosen to be a holy nation in order to proclaim God's excellencies so that more people may know His wonders. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Walking in the Light

Every day, choose to do one good deed that lets others feel God's love and light, whether smiling at a stranger, helping a colleague finish a task, or caring about a friend's needs. These actions all proclaim God's excellencies.
A Family Testimony Time

Hold a testimony time at home regularly, in which each member shares how they have recently experienced God's grace. This not only encourages one another but also lets God's name be honored and proclaimed in the family.
Letters of Light

Each month write a letter of encouragement or thanks to someone who has helped you, letting them know how their kindness reflected God's light, and thanking them for bringing that light into your life.
A Spiritual Reading Group

Organize or join a spiritual reading group that regularly reads and discusses spiritual books. Through this exchange, deepen your knowledge of God's excellencies and encourage one another to live them out in daily life.
Signs of Light

Place small items in your home or workplace that remind you to proclaim God's excellencies, such as a framed Bible verse, a cross, or spiritual books. These items will help you remember your calling at all times.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing us to be Your people and a holy nation. Help us in daily life to proclaim Your excellencies through good deeds, testimony, and encouraging others. May our lives be a reflection of Your glory, drawing more people to know You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out holiness every day, display God's excellencies, and may more people come to know God through the testimony of your life. Amen!

v: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”
b: This verse once again emphasizes our holy identity as God's people. We not only belong to God's kingdom but are the holy citizens He has chosen. This means our whole life should be given to God, lived for His glory. Our words and conduct should reflect this special identity and let the world see God at work in our lives.

It is like a chosen soldier who must not only obey orders but also lead by example, becoming a model in the ranks. In the same way, as holy citizens we should bear witness for God in the world, letting people see our distinctive way of life.

A brother named Liu Zhiyong has always kept devotion and integrity in daily life, and whether facing temptation or difficulty he chooses to stand on God's side. Once, at work, he was shunned for refusing to take part in immoral conduct, but he still held fast to his faith. In the end his perseverance moved his colleagues, and some of them began to take an interest in faith. Zhiyong's life shows what a truly holy citizen is.
Zhiyong's testimony tells us that when we choose to live a holy life, we become a light in this world, drawing people to come before God.
Dear family, let us remember that we are God's holy citizens, entrusted with the mission of glorifying Him. May our whole lives be His witness, bringing His love and light to this world.
ah: This verse reminds us that God has chosen us to be holy citizens, and we should live in daily life in a way that matches this identity. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Morning Commitment
Each morning when you wake, make a commitment to God that today you will face life's challenges with a holy heart, and in the evening reflect on whether you have kept that commitment.
Simplify Your Life
Reduce unnecessary clutter and activities in your life, making your heart and living environment simpler and cleaner, and focusing on what brings you closer to God.
Family Worship
Hold family worship with your family regularly each week, discussing the teaching of Scripture and praying together, giving the whole family to God and making your home a home of holy citizens.
A Holiness Challenge
Challenge yourself to stay away from everything unholy for a set period of time, whether media content, topics of conversation, or thoughts, and record the changes in your heart during that time.
Civic Responsibility

As a holy citizen, take an active part in community activities, promoting justice, integrity, and love, so that your words and actions have a positive influence on those around you, and you become light and salt in society.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing and calling us to be holy citizens. Help us in daily life, at home and in society, to act with a holy heart and to be witnesses of Your grace. May our lives glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you glorify God every day with holy conduct and lead more people to know His truth. Amen!

v: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, as he has spoken.
b: This verse reminds us that, as God's people, our lives should be holy, and that we were chosen by God in order to display His good name and glory. This means we live in this world not only for ourselves but to glorify God. Our every word and deed should reflect our holy identity and let the world see God at work in our lives.

It is like a mirror: when polished, it can clearly reflect the brightness of the light source. In the same way, as God's people we should let our lives become a light in this world, reflecting God's radiance and glory.

A sister named Zhang Ping has always held fast to her faith at home and at work, treating the people around her with love and patience. Whether facing her family's lack of understanding or challenges at work, she relied on God with prayer and faith. Once, when a colleague faced a marriage crisis, seeing Zhang Ping's steady faith in her daily life, she asked Zhang Ping how to face her difficulties. Zhang Ping used the teaching of the Bible and her own experience to help this colleague regain confidence in life, and in the end this colleague also came to church and came to know Jesus.
Zhang Ping's testimony tells us that when we live a holy life, our lives become a witness through which others see God's glory, and we can become God's vessels, leading more people into His presence.
Dear family, let us remember that we are a holy people chosen by God, and our lives should reflect His glory. May we be God's light every day of our lives, spreading His love and truth.
ah: This verse reminds us that God calls us to be His holy people and wants us to live a distinctive life to display His glory. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Sign of Identity

Choose a sign that represents your spiritual identity, whether wearing a cross, jewelry bearing a Scripture verse, or keeping a Bible displayed at home. These signs remind you that you belong to God and encourage you to live a holy life each day.
Daily Gratitude

Spend time each day thanking God for the good name and honor He has given you. Especially in everyday difficulties, learn to face challenges with a thankful attitude, keeping your heart full of gratitude and holiness.
Good-Deed Points

Set up a “good-deed points” system for yourself, recording each good deed you do in life, such as helping others, speaking kind words, or guarding your thoughts. Such a system will help you gradually form habits of a holy life.
A Day of Spiritual Reflection
Choose one day each month as a day of spiritual reflection. Quiet your heart, review whether your conduct matches God's standard of holiness, and set new goals for the days ahead.
Sharing Testimonies
Share what God has done in your life with others, whether in a church group or on social media. Such sharing not only encourages others but also strengthens your own holy identity and calling.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to be Your holy people and for giving us a good name and honor. Help us to live a holy life every day with grateful hearts and glorify Your name through good deeds. May our lives be a witness to Your glory, influencing those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out holiness in every stage of your life, glorify God's name, and lead more people into His light. Amen!

v: She said to her husband, “See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of God who passes by us continually.
b: This verse reminds us that as we live in the world, people should be able to see holiness and godly qualities in our lives. Just as the woman in the passage could recognize that the one passing by was a holy man of God, we too should let those around us sense that we belong to God, and our lives should reflect God's holiness and power.

It is like a fruit-bearing tree: when its fruit is ripe, people can tell at a glance that it is a healthy and vigorous tree. In the same way, if our lives are full of God's holiness and virtue, people will naturally be drawn to us and see God's work in us.

A brother named Li Xingqiang takes an active part in all kinds of public-service activities in his community and treats everyone with honesty and integrity. His neighbors all know he is a Christian and respect the calm and strength that come from his faith. One day, a neighbor going through a family crisis came to Li Qiang's home on his own to ask for help and support. Li Qiang not only gave practical help but also invited him to a church gathering, and in the end this neighbor found his spiritual home in the church.
Xingqiang's testimony tells us that when we live a holy life, our influence goes beyond ourselves and becomes a way for others to know God.
Dear family, let us remember that our lives should be a testimony through which others see God. May we act with a holy heart every day, so that our lives become vessels of God's glory.
ah: This verse reminds us that in daily life we should be alert to, and show respect for, those who carry a holy mission. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Host Preachers
When a preacher or missionary visits the church, take the initiative to invite them to your home as a guest, providing a warm meal or lodging, as a way of showing respect and love for God's servants.
Support Spiritual Leaders

Pray regularly for your church's pastors and spiritual leaders, and support their ministry in practical ways, such as volunteering or giving financially, so that they feel the care and support of believers.
Listen to Spiritual Teaching
When attending church gatherings, set your phone to silent or turn it off, listen attentively to the sermon or teaching, and quietly meditate on how to apply it in your own life.
Learn from Spiritual Examples
Take the initiative to get to know the devout elders or spiritual leaders in the church, learn from their way of life, ask them how to stay holy in daily life, and follow their spiritual disciplines.
Hold a Thanksgiving Event

Organize a thanksgiving event for your church or group, especially thanking the spiritual leaders who quietly serve beside us. This is not only an affirmation of their hard work but also helps us cherish more God's provision in our lives.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for placing spiritual leaders in our lives to lead us on the path of holiness. Help us to respect and support the servants who carry a holy mission, and let us learn from them how to live a godly life. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you show God's holiness in your daily life and be a blessing in the lives of others. Amen!

v: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
b: This verse reminds us that as God's chosen ones, we are called to live holy lives, and our holiness should show in the attitude with which we treat others. Compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience are virtues we should practice in daily life. When we treat others with these virtues, we truly reflect that we are God's beloved, chosen, holy people.

It is like a painter creating a fine painting, where every stroke is carefully crafted and expresses patience and love. The painter cares not only about the rough outline of the picture but even more about the harmony of every detail and the combination of colors. In the same way, in our dealings with others we need to “blend” our words and deeds with compassion, kindness, and patience, so that we can paint in our lives a beautiful picture of God's love.

A brother named Zhang Weihua is often called the “peacemaker” in the church. Whether in church or in daily life, Zhang Weihua always uses love and patience to resolve conflicts and misunderstandings. Once a fierce dispute arose in the church over a decision. Zhang Weihua did not take any side but listened to every voice with a humble heart and mediated with a gentle attitude, and in the end the church was restored to harmony and unity.
Zhang Weihua's testimony tells us that when we treat others with compassion, kindness, and patience, we become ambassadors of God's peace and love, making God's glory more evident in our lives.

Dear family, let us remember that we are the holy and beloved people God has chosen. May we treat others every day with compassion, kindness, and patience, letting our lives be a reflection of God's love, painting a beautiful picture that belongs to God.
ah: This verse reminds us that as God's chosen ones, we should express our faith through holy character, especially through compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Three Good Deeds a Day
Plan to do three good deeds every day, whether for family, friends, or strangers. These could be gentle words, generous help, or patient listening.
Set Aside Moments of Humility
Take time each day to reflect on whether you have stayed humble in how you treat people, and ask God in your heart to give you more humility and gentleness.
Acts of Compassion

Each week choose someone to receive a special act of care, such as visiting a sick friend, bringing food to a family in need, or taking part in a charity event, showing God's compassion through practical action.
A Kindness Journal

Start a kindness journal, recording the difficulties and challenges you meet each day and writing down how you responded with kindness and patience. This will help you keep your heart holy when facing hardship.
Reconcile with Others

Take the initiative to extend a hand of friendship to someone with whom you have had a misunderstanding or conflict, and resolve your differences with a gentle attitude, showing the humility and tolerance a Christian should have.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us Your holy and beloved chosen people. Help us in daily life to live out the virtues of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience, so that our lives may be a testimony to Your love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often show God's love and virtue in your dealings with others, and experience even more grace in those virtues. Amen!

v: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
b: This verse reminds us that when we believe in the Lord and are born again, we become a new self, created in the likeness of God and full of truth, righteousness, and holiness. We are no longer our old selves but should live out the new life God has given, a life that reflects God's holiness and goodness.

It is like a craftsman who carves a rough stone into a fine statue; in the end the statue shows the craftsman's effort and skill. In the same way, when we put on the new self, our lives show God's likeness and His glory, letting people see God's work through us.

A brother named Zhao Gang lived a self-indulgent and selfish life in his youth, but after coming to faith he resolved to change his life and live in a new way. He began to take an active part in church ministry and worked hard to practice his faith at work and at home. At work Zhao Gang treated every colleague with integrity and love, and at home he became a responsible husband and father. His change not only influenced the people around him but also led his family and friends to see the Christian faith anew.

Zhao Gang's testimony tells us that when we put on the new self and live according to God's likeness, our lives become full of strength and meaning, and we become witnesses, in others' eyes, to God's wonderful works.

Dear family, let us remember that God has given us new life, and this life should reflect His holiness and goodness. May we live out this new self every day, letting our lives be vessels that glorify God.
ah: This verse reminds us that as believers we should put off the old self and put on the new self, living a holy life that matches God's likeness. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Morning Prayer for Renewal
Each morning before the day begins, spend a few minutes in prayer, asking God to help you put on spiritual new clothes, to meet the new day with truth and holiness, and to give yourself fully to God.
Set Spiritual Goals

Set a spiritual goal each week, such as strengthening Bible study, practicing fasting and prayer, or learning new skills for serving. These goals can help you keep renewing yourself and live out God's likeness.
Refuse Negative Thinking
When you face negative thoughts or temptations, immediately resist them with Scripture or prayer. This keeps your mind pure and keeps you away from the bondage of the old self.
Pursue a Simple Life
Examine your lifestyle, cut back on unnecessary spending, and choose a simple life. This lets you focus more on spiritual pursuits and your relationship with God.
Keep Examining Yourself
Examine yourself regularly to see whether you are still living in old habits, and make adjustments when needed. This keeps renewing your life so that it conforms more closely to God's likeness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for the chance to become a new creation. Help us put on the new self every day and live, in truth and holiness, a life that is according to Your heart. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you often experience God's grace in your new life, and witness for God with your life. Amen!

v: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
b: This verse reminds us that the church, as the body of Christ, should be holy and spotless. Each of us believers is part of this body, so our words and conduct directly affect the church's witness. When we support one another, encourage one another, and pursue holiness together, we can build a church that pleases God and be light and salt to the world.

It is like a great building, in which every brick must be clean and flawless to make a strong and beautiful house. In the same way, the church's holiness comes from the pursuit and effort of every believer. When each of us pursues holiness in our lives, the church's witness as a whole becomes more powerful.

There is a church that is very well known in its area because its members treat one another with honesty and love. Once a fire broke out in the community, and the members of this church immediately organized themselves, providing food, clothing, and temporary shelter to help the affected residents rebuild their homes. This church's act of love not only helped many people but also let more people see the love of Christ and the strength of the church. Afterward, many who had been helped through this event chose to come to the church and receive Jesus as their Savior.

This church's testimony tells us that when, as the body of Christ, we love one another and work hard to pursue holiness, our church becomes a blessing and a witness to the world, drawing more people into God's presence.

Dear family, let us remember that, as the church of Christ, each of us must work to pursue holiness and, in loving one another, build a glorious church. May our church be a light to this world, drawing more people to the Lord.
ah: This verse reminds us that as the church of Christ we should pursue holiness and become a people without defect in God's eyes. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Join in Cleaning the Church
Take part regularly in the church's cleaning activities and keep the church environment tidy, to show reverence for God and make the church a glorious dwelling place.
A Spiritual Health Check

Just as you have regular physical checkups, have regular spiritual health checks. Examine where you stand on the road of faith, and seek help from a pastor or spiritual partner to keep your spiritual life pure.
Join a Devotional Group

Take an active part in church small groups or devotional activities. Through interaction and sharing with brothers and sisters, pursue spiritual growth together, making the church as a whole more glorious and holy.
Clean Your Heart
Just as you clean a house, regularly reflect on the state of your heart, remove the thoughts and behaviors that defile your spirit, and keep your heart pure and healthy.
Care for Members of the Church
Care for the brothers and sisters in the church, especially those in difficulty or weakness, through prayer, visits, or practical help. This makes the church more harmonious and holy.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us Your church. Help us pursue spiritual cleansing every day and become a people without defect in Your eyes. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out holiness in the church and, together with your brothers and sisters, build a church that pleases God, becoming a blessing to all. Amen!

v: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,
b: This verse reminds us that, as holy brothers and sisters who have been called, we should think often about Jesus Christ. He is our High Priest, our example and our Savior. When we fix our eyes on Jesus, our hearts are continually renewed, and our lives become more and more like His, so that we become holy witnesses.

It is like a ship sailing in the dark of night, which must rely on the North Star to find its direction. In the same way, our lives need Jesus as their navigation, so that we can walk in God's will without wavering amid the storms of this world.

A brother named Wang Qiang met with great challenges in life: his business failed, and his family faced the crisis of breaking apart. In his hardest moment he chose to come to church and spent more time every day in prayer and Bible reading. He entrusted his burdens to the Lord and kept meditating on Jesus' love and sacrifice. As time passed, his faith gradually grew stronger and his life slowly returned to order. Later his family was restored to harmony and his career was born anew, and he gave all the credit to the guidance and protection of Jesus Christ.
Wang Qiang's testimony tells us that when we fix our eyes on Jesus and often think about His works, our lives will be full of strength, and whatever difficulties we meet, we will be able to overcome.

Dear family, let us remember that, as holy brothers and sisters, we should think often about Jesus Christ, letting Him be the center and guide of our lives. May we live a holy life every day by His strength.
ah: This verse reminds us that, as holy brothers, we should think about Jesus at all times and take Him as the example and High Priest of our lives. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Meditate on Jesus Daily
Each morning or before bed, spend time meditating on Jesus' words and His way of life, weaving His example into your own life. This keeps your heart connected to the Lord at all times.
Intercede for Others
Like Jesus the High Priest, pray for those around you in need, especially brothers and sisters going through difficulty and trial. In prayer you can share their burdens with them.
Seek Reconciliation

In daily life, if there is any misunderstanding or conflict with brothers and sisters, take the initiative to seek reconciliation, learning Jesus' forgiveness and love. This preserves the holiness and harmony of the fellowship.
Set Up a Jesus Corner
Set up a spiritual corner at home, with a Bible, a cross, or a picture of Jesus, as a place to think of Jesus each day. This can help you enter quiet prayer and meditation at any time.
Encourage Your Brothers

In small groups or church gatherings, take the initiative to encourage brothers and sisters who are working hard on the spiritual path, sharing your experiences and testimony. In this way we can motivate one another and strengthen our faith.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for making us holy brothers. Help us think of Jesus at all times, learn from His example, and take Him as our strength and hope. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you find strength and comfort in Jesus Christ and, under His guidance, live out a holy life that glorifies God. Amen!

v: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.
b: This verse reminds us that for women who believe in the Lord, a holy life is not only an outward expression but should flow from the heart as reverence for and submission to God. When we treat our families and marriages with devotion and love, our lives become a holy testimony in others' eyes.

It is like a beautiful flower, whose fragrance comes not from its appearance but from its inner nature. In the same way, the beauty of a holy woman comes not only from outward adornment but from the devotion and submission within her heart.

A sister named Chen Meili met with many challenges in her marriage. Her husband often lost his temper because of pressure at work, and for a time the atmosphere at home was very tense. But Meili did not give up. She prayed for her husband every day and faced him with a gentle and submissive attitude. Gradually her husband's attitude began to change. He began to recognize his wife's love and patience, and under her influence he also came to church and in the end received Jesus as his Savior. Meili's submission and love became the key to harmony in the family and also let her husband see the love of Christ.
Meili's testimony tells us that when we face our families with a holy and submissive heart, our lives become a blessing in the eyes of others, and our families are blessed because of it.
Dear family, let us remember that, as children of God, our hearts should be full of devotion and submission, shown in our daily lives, so that our families may be blessed.
ah: This verse reminds us that a holy woman adorns herself with submission and inner virtue, showing the harmony and respect found in a Christian family. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: One Thank-You a Day
Express thanks to your spouse once every day, whether for small things they do or for big contributions. This deepens affection and respect between you.
The Art of Communication

Learn effective communication skills. In conflict or disagreement, express your feelings in a gentle tone and listen patiently to the other's views. This promotes understanding and harmony between husband and wife.
Devotions Together
Set a daily or weekly devotional time with your spouse, reading Scripture and praying together and sharing your spiritual insights with each other. This deepens the spiritual bond between you.
Family Worship
Hold a small family worship regularly at home, letting family members worship God together. This strengthens the family's foundation of faith and promotes spiritual growth among its members.
Practice Mutual Submission

Husband and wife should submit to one another, respect each other's opinions and decisions, and face life's challenges together on the basis of Christ's love. This makes the family stronger and more holy.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us our families. Help us respect and submit to one another in the family, learn the virtue of the holy women of old, and let our families be a testimony to Your love. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live out holiness and love in your marriage and family, and experience harmony and happiness in the home through God's grace. Amen!

v: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
b: This verse reminds us that even in the hardest times, God's chosen ones will hold on to their faith and become holy witnesses. Such people are like the stump that remains after a great tree is cut down; their faith and perseverance will become the foundation of new life in the future.

It is like a tree that has gone through a hard winter. Although it looks withered outside, the life within it is waiting for spring to come, to bloom again. In the same way, as the holy seed, we should hold on to our faith in difficult times, because our perseverance lays the foundation for future blessing.

A brother named Lin Mingsong went through many hardships in his life: unemployment, illness, and family problems came one after another. But he always kept praying and relied on God's word for strength. Even in the hardest moments, he never gave up trusting God. His life testified that even in the most difficult circumstances, God's chosen ones can hold on and become the foundation of future blessing. Later Mingsong's life gradually recovered. He not only found a new job but his family was also restored to harmony. With his testimony he encouraged many brothers and sisters going through difficulty, becoming an example for them.

Mingsong's testimony tells us that when we hold on to our faith in hardship and rely on God's strength, our lives will become a blessing in others' eyes and will lay a solid foundation for future grace.
Dear family, let us remember that, as the holy seed, we should hold on to our faith in difficulty and believe in God's promises. He will surely give us blessings in the future.
ah: This verse reminds us that although circumstances are hard, holy people should be as resilient as a stump and keep the foundation of their faith. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Be Steadfast in Daily Devotions
However busy you are, keep up your devotions and prayer every day. This keeps the foundation of our faith from being affected by the pressures of life, so that it keeps growing.
Build a Spiritual Haven
Set up a spiritual corner at home or work where you can retreat when you meet difficulty, to pray and reflect quietly and regain strength.
Take Part in Spiritual Disciplines
Join the church's spiritual-discipline activities regularly, such as retreats or fasting and prayer. This strengthens your spiritual life so that you can stand firm in trials of faith.
Don't Give Up Easily
When you face spiritual challenges or blows, remind yourself not to give up easily, but, like the roots of a great tree, to sink deep into God's word and hold your stand of faith.
Be a Spiritual Example

In the church or in a small group, take the initiative to be a supporter and encourager of other believers, leading them to hold on to their faith in hardship. This promotes the spiritual growth of the whole group.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for letting us be rooted in Your love. Give us a resilient faith, so that whatever challenges we face, we can hold fast to the path of holiness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold on to your faith in hardship and, in God's grace, become a blessing and a witness in the eyes of others. Amen!

v: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,
b: This verse reminds us that holiness is not an optional choice but God's will for every one of us who believe. Our lives should reflect God's holiness, which requires us to stay away from everything impure in word and deed. Especially in matters of moral purity, we must keep God's teaching.

It is like a cook who, when cooking, must make sure all the ingredients and utensils are clean in order to make healthy and delicious food. In the same way, our hearts and lives should be kept holy so that we can be vessels that please God and fulfill His will.

A sister named Zhang Li often faced moral challenges at work, such as her boss asking her to write a dishonest report, or colleagues encouraging her to join in immoral activities. But Zhang Li always held to her faith and refused everything that did not accord with God's will. Even when she lost a job opportunity because of it, she never wavered. In the end her perseverance was rewarded: she was hired by a company known for its integrity, and her career flourished there. Zhang Li's testimony lets us see that in obeying God's will and staying holy, even if we seem to lose out in the short term, in the end we will be blessed.

Zhang Li's experience tells us that when we hold to holiness in life and stay away from everything impure, we will become vessels that please God, and under God's guidance we will at last receive abundant life.
Dear family, let us remember that God's will is for us to be holy. So let us act carefully in life, staying away from everything impure, and let our lives be a witness to God's glory.
ah: This verse reminds us that an important aspect of a holy life is keeping moral purity and staying away from all kinds of unrighteousness and temptation. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Set Moral Boundaries
In daily life, set clear moral boundaries in your contact with the opposite sex, and avoid falling into the trap of temptation. This protects your own purity and that of others.
Stay Away from Harmful Media
Avoid watching or taking part in entertainment that may lead to sexual immorality, such as immoral movies, websites, or books. This protects your mind and heart.
Cultivate Upright Friends
Keep company with friends who respect moral boundaries and pursue a holy life, encouraging one another and reminding each other to stay morally pure. This creates a positive influence.
Take Part in Marriage Counseling
Whether married or single, regularly attend your church's marriage counseling or sex education classes. This helps you build a healthy view of sexuality in marriage or in preparing for marriage.
Daily Self-Examination

Each night before bed, examine yourself morally and review whether you have stayed holy in word and deed. If you have slipped, confess and repent at once in prayer, asking God to help you walk the right path again.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us moral guidance. Help us stay holy in this world full of temptation, stay away from all unrighteous conduct, and glorify Your holy name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold fast to holiness in every decision and action, walk in God's will, and experience His abundant blessing. Amen!

v: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.
b: This verse reminds us that God's call is for us to leave all uncleanness behind and live a holy life. Our lives should show our separation from the world and live out our identity and mission as children of God. Holiness is not only outward conduct but also purity of the heart within, and this is what God expects of us.

It is like a sculptor who must polish a rough stone into a perfect work of art. In the process he carefully removes each imperfect part until the sculpture is flawless. In the same way, God is carving our lives like this, wanting us to become holy and spotless vessels.

A brother named Lin Nan once lived a life full of all kinds of impure conduct. Drinking, gambling, and violence plunged his family into hardship. But one day he heard the gospel, was deeply moved, and decided to repent and live a new life. He began attending church, and with the help of the pastor and brothers and sisters he gradually left his former way of life and began to pursue holiness. His life went through a great transformation, and he became an example in the church and also led many people in difficulty back into God's arms.
Lin Nan's testimony tells us that when we respond to God's call and choose to live a holy life, our lives will be changed and become a blessing and a witness to others.

Dear family, let us remember that God called us to live a holy life, leaving all uncleanness. So let us stay alert at all times, pursue holiness in life, and let our lives reflect the glory of the children of God.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's call is for us to live a holy life, far from all kinds of uncleanness and sin. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Regularly Clean Your Heart
Set aside time each week for spiritual reflection, checking whether you have been defiled in thought, word, or deed, and ask God to cleanse your heart.
Choose Clean Entertainment
When choosing entertainment, give priority to movies, music, or books that meet the standard of holiness. This helps you keep your thoughts pure.
Spiritual Companionship
Build a regular relationship with a spiritually mature friend or mentor, encouraging one another and holding each other accountable, to help you stay holy on the spiritual road.
Take Part in Spiritual Cleansing
Take part regularly in the church's communion or repentance services. This helps you re-examine your life and receive spiritual cleansing.
Stay Away from Places of Sin
Avoid places that may lead to sin or temptation, such as immoral entertainment venues or gatherings prone to violence. This protects you from the influence of uncleanness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to holiness. Help us keep a clean heart at all times in this world, stay far from all uncleanness and sin, and live a life that pleases You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you hold fast to holiness in life and let God's glorious light shine on the world through your life. Amen!

v: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.
b: This verse reminds us that a holy life is a response to God's commands. We should remember and obey God's word at all times, so that our lives become holy through such obedience. The essence of holiness is that we give ourselves wholly to God and glorify Him in every detail of life.

It is like a gardener who carefully tends every plant, pruning and watering regularly to ensure that they grow healthy and bear flowers and fruit. In the same way, when we obey God's commands and work to pursue holiness in life, our lives will be like these plants, bearing holy fruit that glorifies God's name.

A sister named Xu Jie has loved the Bible since childhood and resolved to give her life wholly to God. Every morning she spends time in prayer and meditating on God's word, and applies what she has learned in daily life. Whether at work or in her relationships, she always takes God's commands as her standard and seeks His heart in everything. Her life is therefore full of God's blessing, and her testimony has drawn many seekers to the church.
Xu Jie's testimony tells us that when we choose to give ourselves wholly to God and obey His commands, our lives will be greatly blessed and will also be a blessing to others.
Dear family, let us remember that we are called to be holy and to give ourselves wholly to God. So let us obey His commands every day, and let our lives be a witness that glorifies Him.
ah: This verse reminds us that obeying God's commands is the way for us to become holy, which allows us to be more closely connected with God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Read the Bible Aloud Daily
Read the Bible aloud at a fixed time each day, especially God's commandments and teachings. This helps you remember and obey God's commands at all times.
Memorize Scripture
Choose some verses about holiness and God's commandments to memorize and often meditate on in life. This plants God's word deep in your heart to become the guide of your conduct.
Put the Commands into Practice
Consciously practice God's commands in daily life, such as loving others as yourself, forgiving, and treating people with integrity. This lets you live out holiness in every area of life.
A Spiritual Keepsake
Carry a small cross or another spiritual keepsake with you, and whenever you see it, remind yourself to obey God's commandments. This helps you keep a holy mindset at all times.
Study Together with Family
Discuss God's commands with your family and look together for ways to practice these commandments at home. This lets the whole family grow together in God's word.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for giving us commandments that guide us toward holiness. Help us to remember and obey Your commands every day and be Your holy people. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you give yourself wholly to God in every decision and action, and live out His glory in holiness. Amen!

v: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God. The LORD your God has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.
b: This verse reminds us that as God's people, we were chosen to belong to God and to be His holy people. Our lives should be set apart from the world, lived in close walk with God. This is our identity and privilege as His people.

It is like a prince who, though born in a palace, must learn how to be a responsible leader, because his identity is different from others. In the same way, as God's people, although we live in this world, we must always remember who we are and live a holy life to display God's glory.

A brother named Wang Jie has always held to the principles of honesty and integrity at work, because he knows he is one of God's people. He refuses to take part in any immoral conduct and does not compromise even in the face of temptation. His perseverance has not only won his colleagues' respect but also given him opportunities to share his faith with them. Wang Jie's life bears witness to God's choosing and grace, and he proves by his actions the special identity of God's people.
Wang Jie's testimony tells us that when we remember who we are and live a holy life, we not only glorify God but also influence those around us, so that they too come to know God's love and grace.

Dear family, let us remember that we are the people God has chosen, and He calls us to live a holy life. So in every action and decision, let us remember our identity and glorify our God with a holy life.
ah: This verse reminds us that God has chosen us to be a holy people, specially belonging to Him, so we should live a life different from the world's that displays God's holiness. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Daily Devotions
Each morning or evening, spend time drawing near to God. Through Bible reading and prayer, let God's word shape your thoughts and conduct, helping you live a holy life.
Serve the Community
Take part in community service or church ministry, showing God's love by serving others, so that you can display God's holiness through practical action.
A Family Altar
Set up a family altar at home, and worship and pray together with your family each week, letting God's holiness fill your home. This helps the whole family grow together in God's grace.
Reflection and Repentance
At the end of each day, reflect on yourself and check whether you have lived a holy life. If you have failed, repent before God at once and ask Him to help you follow His way better.
Live Out Your Testimony
At work, at school, or in daily life, strive to treat people with honesty, integrity, and love, so that your conduct becomes a testimony to God's holiness, drawing more people into His presence.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for choosing us to be Your holy people. Help us live out holiness in our daily lives and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you show the identity of God's people every day of your life, live a holy life, and glorify His name. Amen!

v: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
b: This verse reminds us that God has rescued us from sin and slavery and made us His people. As His people, we are called to match God's holiness and live a holy life. We no longer belong to the world but to God's people, and so our lives should reflect God's holiness.

It is like a child rescued by a loving father from a dangerous place and brought back to a safe home. That child should always remember the father's kindness and live a life that pleases the father. In the same way, we should remember God's rescue and live a holy life in response to His love.

A sister named Liu Xin once lived in chaos, keeping company with a group of bad friends and often taking part in illegal activities. But she happened to hear the gospel, and her heart was deeply shaken. She resolved to repent, leave her past life, and begin to follow Christ. Her life became orderly, and she took an active part in serving in the church, becoming an example everyone admired. Her life bore witness to God's holiness, and her change drew many of her former friends into the church.
Liu Xin's testimony tells us that when we remember God's rescue and choose to live a holy life, our lives will be greatly blessed and can also be a blessing to others.
Dear family, let us remember that God is holy, so we too should be holy. Let us always remember God's rescue in our lives, and in every action glorify our God with a holy life.
ah: This verse reminds us that because God is holy, we should be holy too, as a response to God's grace. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Keep Your Surroundings Clean
Tidy your home regularly and keep your living environment clean. This not only makes your life more comfortable but also symbolizes the holiness of your heart.
Clean Eating
Pay attention to healthy and clean eating habits and choose foods that benefit the body. This helps you reflect God's holiness in your body as well.
Inner Cleanness
Each week spend time examining your thoughts and attitudes, putting away all negative emotions and unclean thoughts, and filling your heart with God's word.
Clean Speech
In daily conversation, work to use positive speech and avoid all foul language and gossip. This lets your speech also reflect God's holiness.
Pass On Clean Messages
Through social media or other platforms, share testimonies or Scripture about a holy life. This helps more people understand and pursue a holy way of living.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for leading us out of darkness into Your light. Help us stay clean in every part of our lives and live a holy life. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you remember God's rescue every day of your life, walk in holiness, and glorify His name. Amen!

v: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”
b: This verse once again reminds us that holiness is what God requires of each of us who believe. We are called to imitate God's holiness and live a distinctive life in this world. Holiness is not only outward conduct but also purity of heart and total commitment to God.

It is like a musician who, when learning an instrument, must keep practicing and improving in order to play beautiful music. In the same way, we need to keep growing and pursuing in our spiritual lives in order to live a holy life and be God's witnesses.

A brother named Zhang Anqiang holds to integrity and uprightness as principles at work and refuses to take part in any immoral conduct. Even when he met with exclusion and misunderstanding because of it, he never gave up trusting God. His life testified to God's holiness, and by his own example he influenced many colleagues and won respect for Christ.
Anqiang's testimony tells us that when we choose to live a holy life, we not only glorify God but also become examples for others, leading more people toward the truth.
Dear family, let us remember that God calls us to be holy, because He is holy. Let us glorify our God with a holy life every day.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's holiness is the standard for our lives, and we are called to imitate His holiness in all things. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life in the following five ways:
a: Cultivate Spiritual Character

Each week choose one spiritual quality (such as love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, or self-control) as your focus for the week, and work to practice it in your life, gradually becoming a more holy person.
Join a Devotional Small Group
Join or organize a devotional small group that regularly studies the Bible and shares testimonies with other believers. This lets you encourage one another and pursue holiness together.
Set Spiritual Goals
Set short-term and long-term spiritual goals for yourself, whether in prayer, Bible reading, or service. This keeps motivating you to go forward on the path of holiness.
Keep Your Heart Pure
Set aside time each day to meditate on God's word, and stay away from media or activities that pollute our hearts, so that our hearts stay pure and focused.
Dedicate the Small Things of Life
Offer the small things of daily life (such as housework, work, and commuting) to God, doing them with a devout heart, so that every small detail reflects our pursuit of God's holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to a holy life. Give us strength to obey Your teaching and imitate Your holiness every day of our lives. We pray in the victorious name of the Lord Jesus, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you choose holiness in every decision of your life, walk in God's light, and witness to His glory. Amen!

v: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.
b: This verse reminds us that holiness should be a basic principle in how believers relate to one another. In dealing with brothers and sisters, we should have a holy attitude, respecting and caring for one another, and our words and conduct should reflect that we belong to God. In this way we can build real fellowship in the church and witness to God's love.

It is like a family, whose members should respect and cherish one another in order to build a harmonious and happy home. In the same way, as part of God's great family, we should be holy toward one another, so that the church can be a place full of love and peace.

A sister named Li Fen has always been known in the church for caring for and respecting others. She takes the initiative to care for brothers and sisters in need and is very careful in word and deed, never hurting others' feelings. Her love and holiness have made her an example in the church, and because of her influence many people have learned how to love one another in Christ.
Li Fen's testimony tells us that when we are holy toward one another in the church, we not only build a harmonious fellowship but also become a blessing to others and witness to God's love.

Dear family, let us remember that being holy toward one another is a principle we should keep in the church. In every interaction with brothers and sisters, let us treat others with a holy attitude, build harmonious relationships, and glorify God's name.
ah: This verse reminds us that holiness is not only a personal pursuit but also a condition we should keep among one another. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Keep Friendships Clean
Keep your interactions with friends clean and respectful, and stay away from any conduct or words that might spoil the purity of the friendship. This makes your relationships more glorifying to God.
Build a Holy Family Culture
Build a holy culture in your family, for example by praying before meals and playing worship music at home. This fills the atmosphere of the whole family with God's presence.
Take Part in Church Fellowship
Take an active part in the church's fellowship activities, growing in faith together through mutual support and encouragement, and pursuing holiness together.
Daily Greetings
In daily life, greet the people around you with a holy attitude, whether friends, family, or colleagues, so that every greeting conveys God's love and holiness.
Build a Spiritual Partnership
Form a spiritual partnership with a brother or sister in the church, praying for each other and sharing what you have learned in spiritual growth. This helps both of you grow together in holiness.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for joining us together in Christ. Help us stay holy as we interact with others, so that every relationship of ours reflects Your love and holiness. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you treat every brother and sister in the church with a holy attitude and, in love, build God's kingdom. Amen!

v: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,
b: This verse reminds us that holiness is not confined to certain specific areas but should cover every aspect of our lives. Whether at work, at home, or in our words and conduct, we should reflect God's holiness. This is a principle we as Christians should follow.

It is like a sculptor who, in creating a work of art, polishes both the large outline and the finest details, making sure every part reaches perfection. In the same way, every action and decision in our lives, big choices or small gestures, should reflect holiness.

A brother named Wang Jiayong always holds himself to the highest standard at work. Whether a big project or a small task, he treats them alike and strives for excellence. This attitude has not only won him success at work but also made him an example among his colleagues, and many people have begun to change their own attitude toward work because of his influence. His life reflects God's holiness, and by his actions he has witnessed to God's love.
Jiayong's testimony tells us that when we take holiness as our standard in all things, we can not only be God's witnesses but also influence those around us and pass God's love on to them.
Dear family, let us remember that God calls us to be holy in all things. In every action, let us take holiness as our standard, glorify God's name, and witness to His love in our lives.
ah: This verse reminds us that holiness should cover every level of our lives, whether in thought, word, or deed. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Purify Your Thoughts
Spend time each day examining your thoughts, putting away every impure thought, and renewing your heart with God's word, so that your mind stays pure.
Speak Positive Words
When talking with others, choose positive and encouraging words and avoid anything that might hurt others or fail to honor God. This keeps your speech holy.
Dedicate Your Work
At work, do every task, big or small, with a holy attitude and with the heart of working for God, so that every detail of your work can glorify God.
Cleanse Your Heart
Reflect on your heart each day, ask God for forgiveness and cleansing, and ask the Holy Spirit to help you stay away from sin and stand firm in holiness.
Family Prayer
Set a daily prayer time with your family, whether in the morning, in the evening, or before meals. This helps the whole family pursue holiness together and become a family that pleases God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to be Your holy people. Help us stay holy in every detail of our lives and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you show God's holiness in every detail of your life and be a blessing to others. Amen!

v: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,
b: This verse reminds us that, facing the fact that everything in this world will in the end pass away, we should fix our eyes on eternal values. So our lives should aim at holiness and godliness, and stay away from fleeting pursuits not worth investing in. Our lives should reflect that we belong to God, and all our conduct should accord with His will.

It is like a gardener who understands that flowers, though beautiful, will eventually fade, so he puts more of his energy into cultivating the trees that bear fruit. The gardener knows that this fruit is what lasts and has value. In the same way, we should put our energy into eternal things and live a holy and godly life, for this is what is meaningful and valuable.

A sister named Lin Jie reflected deeply on her life during a sudden illness. She had often been busy pursuing success in her career while neglecting her spiritual growth. This experience made her understand that however great her achievements, they could never bring her true satisfaction in the end. So she resolved to change, began to put more time into devotions and service, and took an active part in the church's ministries. Her life became fuller and more meaningful because of it.
Lin Jie's testimony tells us that when we turn our focus to eternal values and choose to live a holy and godly life, our lives will find true satisfaction and blessing.
Dear family, let us remember that in this passing world we should aim at holiness and godliness. Let us each day choose the things that bring eternal value, and glorify God's name.
ah: This verse reminds us that everything in the world will pass away, so we should live in daily life with an attitude of holiness and godliness. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Keep Your Surroundings Clean
Spend some time every day tidying and cleaning your living space. This not only raises the quality of life but also symbolizes our pursuit of holiness in heart and conduct.
Godly Time Management

Arrange each day's time wisely, giving priority to important spiritual activities such as devotions, prayer, and church involvement, so that even your time management reflects a godly attitude toward life.
Family Worship Time
Hold family worship with your family regularly. It not only improves your relationships but also lets the whole family grow together in the Lord and live a holy life.
Read Spiritual Books
Choose one spiritual book to read each month, filling your mind with sound teaching, so that you pursue holiness and godliness at the level of your thoughts.
Share Your Faith Experience
At work or in social settings, take the initiative to share your testimony of faith and encourage others through the story of your own experience. In this way you show a godly life in practice.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for reminding us that everything in this world will pass away. Help us live a holy and godly life every day and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you choose to live a holy and godly life and find true satisfaction in God's love. Amen!

v: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.
b: This verse reminds us that as Christians our lives should show the qualities of holiness and righteousness. Our conduct and words should be blameless, a witness in the eyes of others, and God also bears witness to our lives. We live not only before people but before God, so we should be careful in how we live each day.

It is like a craftsman who, when making a fine work of art, hopes not only to win the buyer's praise but even more to have his work approved by a master. In the same way, our lives should be equally blameless before God and before people, so that we can glorify God and witness for Him.

A brother named Chen Wei keeps extremely high moral standards at home and at work. He is strict with himself and also helps those around him live upright lives. Once, when the company was considering layoffs because of poor performance, Chen Wei's honesty and diligence made him the only employee kept on. His boss said to him, “We trust you, not just because of your ability but even more because of your character.” Chen Wei's life testified to what holiness and righteousness are, and so glorified God.
Chen Wei's testimony tells us that when we choose to live a holy and righteous life, we not only earn people's respect but also bear witness for God.
Dear family, let us remember that our lives should show the qualities of holiness and righteousness. Let us choose each day to live a blameless life and glorify God's name.
ah: This verse reminds us that our lives should be holy, righteous, and blameless, so that we can be a good witness before others and before God. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Take the Initiative to Resolve Conflict

When a misunderstanding or conflict arises with others, take the initiative to seek reconciliation and resolve the dispute with love and wisdom. In this way you can show holiness and righteousness in such situations.
Keep Your Promises
Take every promise seriously, big or small, and work to keep it. In this way you can show a blameless character before others.
Stay Honest
At work, at school, or in daily life, be honest with people and avoid any form of deception. In this way your life becomes a good witness before others.
Be Generous
Help those in need generously, whether materially or spiritually. In this way, through giving, you can show righteousness and love.
Hold to Your Principles of Faith

When you face temptation or pressure, always hold to your principles of faith and do not compromise with worldly standards. In this way you can show a holy and blameless character before God and people.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for calling us to be a holy, righteous, and blameless people. Help us be a good witness before others and before You in our daily lives. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you show holiness and righteousness in your life and give a beautiful witness for God. Amen!

v: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
b: This verse reminds us that holiness is not only a personal pursuit; it also affects the people around us. When we choose to live a holy life, we are like the first fruit that is offered, and we can make the environment and the circle of relationships around us holy too. Our holy life will become a blessing to others and draw more people to God.

It is like a healthy tree, whose roots are firm and strong, which makes the trunk straight and tall and the branches flourishing, full of fruit. In the same way, when the foundation of our spiritual life is holy, our lives and the relationships we influence will become abundant and healthy too.

A sister named Zhang Lan started a small group in her community that regularly shares the Bible and prays with her neighbors. With her holy life as an example, she led many neighbors toward faith. Some neighbors had not been on good terms with each other, but after the group began, everyone started caring about and helping one another more. The group became a blessing to the community, where everyone grew together in holiness and showed the love of Christ in daily life.
Zhang Lan's testimony tells us that when we choose to live a holy life, we can change not only ourselves but also the environment around us, so that more people are blessed.
Dear family, let us remember that a holy life has far-reaching influence. Let us choose each day to live a holy life, be a blessing to others, and glorify God's name.
ah: This verse reminds us that holiness begins at the root; when the foundation is holy, our whole life and influence will be holy too. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Examine the Foundation of Your Life

Take time to consider whether the foundation of your life is built on God's word and faith, and seek God's guidance to improve whatever does not accord with His heart. In this way your whole life can become more holy.
Start with Your Family
In your family, be an example of holy living. Whether in parents teaching children or in interaction between spouses, take holiness as the standard, so that the whole family is blessed before God.
Influence Those Around You
At work or in social settings, influence the people around you with upright and holy conduct, guiding others onto the right path through the testimony of your life.
Build spiritual habits, such as daily Bible reading, prayer, and devotions, and let these holy habits become the foundation of your life, so that they influence all your words and actions.
Take Part in Church Ministry

Take an active part in the church's various ministries, whether children's ministry, the worship team, or care ministry. In this way your service can become a foundation for building up others' faith and bring holy influence.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for helping us understand the importance of holiness beginning at the foundation. Help us take holiness as the standard in every area of life, influencing ourselves and those around us. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you live in holiness and witness to God's grace as you influence others. Amen!

v: Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your mighty acts? The yearning of your heart and your compassion is restrained toward me.
b: This verse reminds us that God's dwelling is holy and glorious, and from there He watches over our lives. His love and compassion never cease, and His mighty works can be seen in our lives at any time. We need to build our own lives into a holy dwelling too, letting God's Spirit live in our hearts and display His glory through us.

It is like a craftsman who spends time and effort carefully building a warm and beautiful home where the family can find safety and comfort. In the same way, our hearts need to be carefully built like this, becoming a holy place where God dwells, so that His love and power can work in our lives.

A sister named Liu Ya resolved to spend time each morning drawing near to God, offering her heart as a holy dwelling. In prayer she experienced God's presence and guidance, which made her more confident in facing life's challenges. This habit of hers also influenced her family. Seeing the change in their mother, the children began to learn to pray and read the Bible, and the atmosphere of the home became more harmonious as a result.
Liu Ya's testimony tells us that when we build our hearts into a holy dwelling, God's love and power will be revealed in our lives, and our lives will become a blessing to others.
Dear family, let us remember that our hearts should be God's holy dwelling. Let us offer our hearts to God every day, and let His love and power work in our lives.
ah: This verse reminds us that God's holiness and glory are not only our protection but also our hope, and we should live in reverence and humility before Him. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: A Life of Devout Prayer
Pray to God at a fixed time each day, seeking His guidance and protection. This keeps you protected in God's holiness and presence at all times.
Learn Humility
In dealing with others, keep a humble attitude, and whether at home or at work put others' needs first. In this way you can better reflect God's compassion and love.
Meditate on God's Works

Set aside time each day to meditate on what God has done in your life, recalling how He has led you through difficulties and challenges. This encourages you to trust God's holiness and power all the more.
Take Part in Worship

Take an active part in the church's worship, whether Sunday service or small-group worship, letting your heart be filled with God's holiness. This strengthens your power to pursue holiness in daily life.
A Gratitude Journal
Write down each day the things you are thankful to God for, big or small. This helps you keep sensing God's love and compassion and bring that thankful attitude into every corner of life.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for looking down on us from Your holy and glorious dwelling. Help us, under Your protection and compassion, live devout and humble lives and glorify Your name. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you become part of God's holy dwelling and find rest and peace in His love. Amen!

v: Our holy and our beautiful house where our fathers praised you is burned with fire. All our pleasant places are laid waste.
b: This verse reminds us that the holy temple is where God meets with us, the place where we worship and praise Him. When such a holy place is destroyed, our hearts feel pain and loss. Yet we are also reminded that we ourselves are the temple of the Holy Spirit, the place where God dwells, so we should do our best to keep our hearts holy.

It is like an old church, whose outer building may decay with time, but whose faith and devotion within can stay fresh through the years. In the same way, our lives are also God's temple, and we should protect it, making it a holy place where God can dwell.

A brother named Wu Xiao lost his home and church in an earthquake, a tremendous blow to him. But he did not give up his faith because of it. Instead he worked even harder to build a spiritual temple in his heart, drawing near to God every day. He also threw himself into the rebuilding work, leading many people to keep looking to God's grace and strength in hardship. In the end he not only rebuilt his physical home but also built a spiritual home in the community.
Wu Xiao's testimony tells us that however the outward circumstances change, we should keep our hearts holy, let our lives be God's temple, and find strength in our faith.
Dear family, let us remember that our lives should be like a holy temple where God's Spirit can dwell. Let us keep our hearts holy every day and trust God without wavering in any circumstance.
ah: This verse reminds us that a holy place is where God meets with us, and we should cherish and protect such spiritual places. We can put the truth of this verse into practice in daily life through the following concrete actions:
a: Care for the Church

Take the initiative to take part in the church's upkeep, whether cleaning the sanctuary, repairing facilities, or giving to the maintenance fund, supporting the holiness and beauty of the church through action.
Guard the Spiritual Atmosphere
At church or small-group gatherings, keep an attitude of reverence and respect and do nothing that disturbs others' worship. This makes the church a truly holy place of worship.
Set Up a Family Altar
Set aside a fixed place at home as a family altar for daily devotions and prayer, making it a holy place where you meet intimately with God.
Design a Devotional Space
Design a quiet devotional space at home, arranged with spiritual books, a cross, or hymns. This helps you draw near to God more fully in that space.
Protect the Holiness of Your Heart
Remind yourself at all times to keep your heart holy and avoid letting negative thoughts and feelings enter it. This makes your heart a holy dwelling for God.
pr: Dear Heavenly Father, thank You for helping us understand the importance of holy places. Help us cherish and protect these spiritual places, and build spiritual altars in our hearts and homes to draw near to You. We pray in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, amen.
dc: In the name of the Lord, I bless you. May you become a holy temple where God's Spirit moves freely within you, giving you strength and comfort. Amen!
